zh: 请解释原文的 Nef abundance 方法在光滑 K3 曲面上怎样运作。先看原文的一般证明在这个情形中的具体形式。
en: How does the original Nef abundance method work on a smooth K3 surface? First explain the specialization of the paper’s general proof.

zh: 这里的 \(B\) 是有效有理边界，还是任意 nef 除子？
en: Does \(B\) mean an effective rational boundary, or an arbitrary nef divisor?

zh: 我指任意 nef 除子 \(B\)，不是有效边界；要看的是 Nef abundance 那篇文章。
en: I mean an arbitrary nef divisor \(B\), not an effective boundary. The intended paper is the one on Nef abundance.

zh: 对应文章是 Numerical Semiampleness of Nef Adjoint Divisors。原文将有效边界记为 \(B\)，将任意 nef 除子记为 \(M\)。沿用你的记号，下文的 \(B\) 表示 nef 除子，对应原文的 \(M\)；原文边界取零。
en: The corresponding paper is Numerical Semiampleness of Nef Adjoint Divisors. It denotes the effective boundary by \(B\) and the arbitrary nef divisor by \(M\). In your notation, \(B\) below denotes the nef divisor corresponding to the paper’s \(M\); the boundary in the paper is set to zero.

zh: 在光滑射影 K3 曲面上，
\[K_X\sim0,\qquad B\ \text{nef 且为 }\mathbb Q\text{-除子}.\]
文章的主定理声称
\[B\equiv A,\qquad A\ \text{semiample}.\]
K3 曲面上数值平凡线丛是平凡线丛，因此这一结论进一步给出
\[B\sim_{\mathbb Q}A\quad\Longrightarrow\quad |mB|\ \text{对某个 }m>0\text{ 无基点}.\]
这里只将文章的结论代入 K3，未验证其证明。待核查的是如何产生 \(A\)，尤其 \(B^2=0\) 时截面从哪里来。
en: On a smooth projective K3 surface,
\[K_X\sim0,\qquad B\ \text{is a nef }\mathbb Q\text{-divisor}.\]
The main theorem of the paper claims
\[B\equiv A,\qquad A\ \text{is semiample}.\]
A numerically trivial line bundle on a K3 surface is trivial, so this conclusion further gives
\[B\sim_{\mathbb Q}A\quad\Longrightarrow\quad |mB|\ \text{is basepoint-free for some }m>0.\]

This only specializes the paper’s conclusion to K3; its proof has not been checked. What remains to be examined is how the paper produces \(A\), especially where the sections come from when \(B^2=0\).

zh: 请将原文证明一般结论的方法代入光滑射影 K3 曲面，不要换成独立的 Riemann–Roch 证明或专门的 K3 定理。目标是数值有效：对 nef Cartier 除子 \(D\)，找到有效 \(\mathbb Q\)-除子 \(E\) 使 \(D\equiv E\)。
en: Specialize the paper’s proof of the general result to a smooth projective K3 surface; do not replace it with a standalone Riemann–Roch proof or a special K3 theorem. The target is numerical effectivity: for a nef Cartier divisor \(D\), find an effective \(\mathbb Q\)-divisor \(E\) with \(D\equiv E\).

zh: 原文的有效边界取零，nef 部分对应这里的 \(D\)。我们考察的是光滑射影曲面 \(X\)、\(K_X\sim0\) 时的一般证明，目标仍是 \(D\equiv E\)。
en: The effective boundary in the paper is zero, and its nef summand corresponds to our \(D\). We are examining the general proof for a smooth projective surface \(X\) with \(K_X\sim0\); the target remains \(D\equiv E\).

zh: 回顾一下 nef reduction 和 nef dimension 的定义。
en: Recall the definitions of nef reduction and nef dimension.

zh: 对 nef 除子 \(D\)，nef reduction 是支配的、几乎全纯的有理映射
\[f_D:X\dashrightarrow Y\]
其纤维连通；在一般的、具有预期维数的紧纤维上，\(D\) 数值平凡。经过非常一般点、且不被收缩的整曲线 \(C\) 满足 \(D\cdot C>0\)。
\[n(X,D)=\dim Y.\]
曲面上 \(n(X,D)=2\) 并不按定义推出 \(D^2>0\)。
en: For a nef divisor \(D\), the nef reduction is a dominant, almost holomorphic rational map
\[f_D:X\dashrightarrow Y\]

with connected fibres. The divisor \(D\) is numerically trivial on a general compact fibre of the expected dimension. Every integral curve \(C\) through a very general point that is not contracted satisfies \(D\cdot C>0\).
\[n(X,D)=\dim Y.\]
On a surface, \(n(X,D)=2\) does not imply \(D^2>0\) by definition.

zh: 为什么 nef dimension 不能是零？
en: Why can the nef dimension not be zero?

zh: 可以是零。\(n(X,D)=0\) 当且仅当 \(D\equiv0\)，此时直接取 \(E=0\)。在处理完这个情形并假设 \(D\not\equiv0\) 后，才只剩 \(n(X,D)=1\) 或 \(2\)。
也不能用“曲线只有可数条”来推出 \(n(X,D)=2\)：K3 上的曲线不必形成可数集，椭圆纤维化就有一族纤维。
en: It can be zero. We have \(n(X,D)=0\) if and only if \(D\equiv0\), in which case take \(E=0\). Only after treating this case and assuming \(D\not\equiv0\) do the possibilities reduce to \(n(X,D)=1\) or \(2\).
Nor can one infer \(n(X,D)=2\) by claiming that there are only countably many curves: curves on a K3 surface need not form a countable set; an elliptic fibration has a family of fibres.
When \(D^2=0\), how is \(n(X,D)=2\) excluded?

zh: 若 \(n(X,D)=1\)，在双有理模型 \(p:\widetilde X\to X\) 上，nef reduction 的下降给出到底曲线的映射 \(f:\widetilde X\to C\)，以及 \(C\) 上的除子 \(A\)，满足
\[p^*D\equiv f^*A,\qquad \deg A\ge0.\]
曲线上 \(A\equiv a[c]\)、\(a\ge0\)。将这一有效数值代表拉回再推前，得到 \(D\) 的有效数值代表。这一步使用下降引理，不只是 nef reduction 的定义。
若 \(n(X,D)=2\)，原文声称：\(K_X\sim0\) 时满 nef dimension 的一般定理推出 \(D\) big，与 \(D^2=0\) 矛盾。它通过 Frobenius 比较喷射估计；两个核心几何估计尚未完整核查，所以这仍是论文声称的排除路径，不是已完成的验证。不能把它改写成不需要 \(K_X\sim0\) 的独立小体积喷射论证。
en: If \(n(X,D)=1\), descent for the nef reduction on a birational model \(p:\widetilde X\to X\) gives a map \(f:\widetilde X\to C\) to a curve and a divisor \(A\) on \(C\) such that
\[p^*D\equiv f^*A,\qquad \deg A\ge0.\]

On the curve, \(A\equiv a[c]\) with \(a\ge0\). Pulling back this effective numerical representative and then pushing it forward gives an effective numerical representative of \(D\). This uses a descent lemma, not merely the definition of nef reduction.

If \(n(X,D)=2\), the paper claims that its general full-nef-dimension theorem for \(K_X\sim0\) makes \(D\) big, contradicting \(D^2=0\). The proof compares jet estimates via Frobenius. The two core geometric estimates have not been fully audited, so this is the paper’s claimed exclusion route, not a completed verification. It is not a standalone small-volume jet argument that dispenses with \(K_X\sim0\).

zh: 这里的两个 jet 命题具体在说什么？
en: What exactly do the two jet statements say here?

zh: 在反例情形，\(X\) 是光滑射影曲面，\(K_X\sim0\)，\(D\) 是 nef Cartier 除子，\(n(X,D)=2\)，\(D^2=0\)。取 ample Cartier 除子 \(A\)，以及正有理数 \(\varepsilon\)，满足
\[(14\varepsilon)^2<\tfrac14,\qquad80\varepsilon<\tfrac34.\]
直接选择正整数 \(r_n\to\infty\)，使
\[P_n=r_n(D+A/n),\qquad P_n^2\longrightarrow\varepsilon^2.\]
例如，略去有限个初始项后，将 \(\varepsilon/\sqrt{(D+A/n)^2}\) 四舍五入到最近的正整数。
原文的第一个声明：对所有充分大的 \(n\)、非常一般的光滑点 \(x\in X\)，对每个 \(k>0\) 使 \(kP_n\) 为 Cartier，以及每个非零截面 \(s\in H^0(X,\mathcal O_X(kP_n))\)，有
\[\operatorname{ord}_x(s)\le4k\sqrt{P_n^2}.\]
这里的消失阶，是在局部平凡化下 \(s_x\in\mathfrak m_x^a\) 所允许的最大 \(a\)。这一核心估计尚未完整核查。
en: In the counterexample case, \(X\) is a smooth projective surface, \(K_X\sim0\), \(D\) is nef Cartier, \(n(X,D)=2\), and \(D^2=0\). Choose an ample Cartier divisor \(A\) and a positive rational \(\varepsilon\) satisfying
\[(14\varepsilon)^2<\tfrac14,\qquad80\varepsilon<\tfrac34.\]
Directly choose positive integers \(r_n\to\infty\) such that
\[P_n=r_n(D+A/n),\qquad P_n^2\longrightarrow\varepsilon^2.\]
For example, after discarding finitely many initial terms, round \(\varepsilon/\sqrt{(D+A/n)^2}\) to the nearest positive integer.

The first claim in the paper is that, for all sufficiently large \(n\), a very general smooth point \(x\in X\), every \(k>0\) with \(kP_n\) Cartier, and every nonzero section \(s\in H^0(X,\mathcal O_X(kP_n))\),
\[\operatorname{ord}_x(s)\le4k\sqrt{P_n^2}.\]
In a local trivialization, the order is the largest \(a\) such that \(s_x\in\mathfrak m_x^a\). This core estimate has not been fully audited.

zh: 第二个声明在辅助空间上。记 \(p_1,p_2:X\times X\to X\)，取
\[\pi:Z=\mathbb P\!\left(p_1^*\mathcal O_X(D)\oplus p_2^*\mathcal O_X(D)\right)\longrightarrow X\times X.\]
使用 \(\pi_*\mathcal O_Z(a)=\operatorname{Sym}^a(p_1^*\mathcal O_X(D)\oplus p_2^*\mathcal O_X(D))\)、\(a\ge0\) 的约定。此时 \(\dim Z=5\)。令
\[\xi=c_1\mathcal O_Z(1),\quad P_{n,i}=\pi^*p_i^*P_n,\quad R_n=P_{n,1}+P_{n,2}+q\xi.\]
原文声称：选定一个固定正整数 \(q\) 后，对所有充分大的 \(n\)，存在不在两个自然截面上的光滑点 \(z\)，使
\[\epsilon(R_n;z)=\inf_{C\ni z}\frac{R_n\cdot C}{\operatorname{mult}_z C}>6.\]
于是，对充分大且可除的 \(k_0\)，有满射
\[H^0(Z,\mathcal O_Z(k_0R_n))\longrightarrow\mathcal O_Z(k_0R_n)_z\otimes_{\mathcal O_{Z,z}}\left(\mathcal O_{Z,z}/\mathfrak m_z^{6k_0+1}\right).\]
也就是说，五个局部坐标中任意总次数不超过 \(6k_0\) 的 Taylor 多项式，都可由一个全局截面实现。这比“存在一个高阶消失截面”更强。
这一满射推论通过在 \(z\) 处吹起 \(b\)、取有理数 \(6<a<\epsilon(R_n;z)\)，利用 \(b^*R_n-aG\) 的 ample 性和 Serre 消失得到；\(G\) 是例外除子。第二个核心几何估计仍未完整核查。两种估计在不同空间上，必须经过原文的 Frobenius 比较，不能仅把它们并列就得出矛盾。
en: The second claim is on an auxiliary space. Write \(p_1,p_2:X\times X\to X\), and let
\[\pi:Z=\mathbb P\!\left(p_1^*\mathcal O_X(D)\oplus p_2^*\mathcal O_X(D)\right)\longrightarrow X\times X.\]
Use the convention \(\pi_*\mathcal O_Z(a)=\operatorname{Sym}^a(p_1^*\mathcal O_X(D)\oplus p_2^*\mathcal O_X(D))\) for \(a\ge0\). Then \(\dim Z=5\). Set
\[\xi=c_1\mathcal O_Z(1),\quad P_{n,i}=\pi^*p_i^*P_n,\quad R_n=P_{n,1}+P_{n,2}+q\xi.\]
The paper claims that, after choosing a fixed positive integer \(q\), for all sufficiently large \(n\) there is a smooth point \(z\) outside the two natural sections such that
\[\epsilon(R_n;z)=\inf_{C\ni z}\frac{R_n\cdot C}{\operatorname{mult}_z C}>6.\]
Consequently, for sufficiently large divisible \(k_0\), the following map is surjective:
\[H^0(Z,\mathcal O_Z(k_0R_n))\longrightarrow\mathcal O_Z(k_0R_n)_z\otimes_{\mathcal O_{Z,z}}\left(\mathcal O_{Z,z}/\mathfrak m_z^{6k_0+1}\right).\]

Thus every prescribed Taylor polynomial of total degree at most \(6k_0\) in five local coordinates can be realized by a global section. This is stronger than the existence of one section with high vanishing order.

This surjectivity follows by blowing up \(z\), with blowup map \(b\) and exceptional divisor \(G\), choosing a rational \(6<a<\epsilon(R_n;z)\), and using the ampleness of \(b^*R_n-aG\) and Serre vanishing. The second core geometric estimate has not been fully audited. The two estimates live on different spaces: the paper’s Frobenius comparison is needed, and simply juxtaposing them gives no contradiction.

zh: 后面的研读回复请用英文写。
en: Please write the subsequent study explanations in English.

zh: 后续笔记与正式引理用英文整理；这里保留对应的双语研读记录。
en: The subsequent note and formal lemmas are written in English; corresponding bilingual study records are retained here.

zh: 请先整理成临时英文学习笔记，写出所讨论引理的具体陈述与证明。
en: Please prepare a temporary English study note with explicit statements and proofs of the lemmas discussed.

zh: 笔记按已讨论内容整理，区分已经展开的曲面步骤与仍待核查的原文断言。
en: The note separates the surface arguments already expanded from assertions in the original paper that remain unchecked.

zh: 直接专门化到曲面，不要留下抽象的低维断言作为额外假设。
en: Specialize directly to surfaces; do not leave an abstract lower-dimensional assertion as an extra assumption.

zh: 一维的正性输入由次数给出：
\[\deg T\ge0,\quad\deg N\ge0,\quad\deg(T+aN)>0\ \text{对某个 }a>0.\]
则对每个 \(c>0\)，\(\deg(T+cN)>0\)，所以 \(T+cN\) big。曲面讨论不再保留一个额外的抽象一维假设。
这里的不 big 来自已设定的 \(D^2=0\)；单独的 \(n(X,D)=2\) 并不意味着不 big。
en: The dimension-one positivity input follows from degrees:
\[\deg T\ge0,\quad\deg N\ge0,\quad\deg(T+aN)>0\ \text{for some }a>0.\]
Then \(\deg(T+cN)>0\) for every \(c>0\), so \(T+cN\) is big. No additional abstract dimension-one assumption remains in the surface discussion.
Here non-bigness comes from the stipulated \(D^2=0\); \(n(X,D)=2\) alone does not mean that \(D\) is not big.

zh: 引理只用编号，不加 scalar bound 等自拟副标题。每个引理写清全部条件，并直接说明曲面情形。
en: Use plain numbered lemmas without invented subtitles such as “scalar bound.” State every hypothesis explicitly and specialize to surfaces.

zh: 采用普通引理编号，逐条列出对象和假设；不以额外副标题代替准确陈述。
en: Use plain lemma numbering and explicit objects and hypotheses, rather than explanatory subtitles.

zh: 能否直接用 \(A/n\) 定义 \(P_n\)，不另外引入小参数？
en: Can we define \(P_n\) directly using \(A/n\), without introducing an extra small parameter?

zh: 可以。直接定义
\[P_n=r_n(D+A/n),\qquad r_n\longrightarrow\infty,\qquad P_n^2\longrightarrow\varepsilon^2.\]
无需额外参数。相应的 \(R_n\) 和喷射估计仍要求 \(n\) 充分大；\(n\) 是序列下标，不是 nef dimension。核心喷射估计和 Frobenius 比较的证明仍未完整核查。
en: Yes. Define directly
\[P_n=r_n(D+A/n),\qquad r_n\longrightarrow\infty,\qquad P_n^2\longrightarrow\varepsilon^2.\]

No extra parameter is needed. The corresponding \(R_n\) and the jet estimates still require sufficiently large \(n\); \(n\) is the sequence index, not the nef dimension. The proofs of the core jet estimates and the Frobenius comparison remain unaudited.

zh: 我说的是 \(1/n\to0\)，不是固定的 \(1/2\)。直接用 \(P_n=r_n(D+A/n)\)，不要再引入 \(t\) 或 \(t_n\)。
en: I mean \(1/n\to0\), not the fixed value \(1/2\). Use \(P_n=r_n(D+A/n)\) directly, without \(t\) or \(t_n\).

zh: 按最终意图采用 \(A/n\)。\(r_n\) 的取整与自交数收敛作为独立初步引理说明。
en: Use \(A/n\) as intended. Explain integer rounding for \(r_n\) and convergence of the self-intersection in a separate preliminary lemma.

zh: \(P_n^2\to\varepsilon^2\) 是什么意思？这里选取的乘数和 \(R_n\) 有什么区别？
en: What does \(P_n^2\to\varepsilon^2\) mean? How does the chosen multiplier differ from \(R_n\)?

zh: 箭头表示数值自交数的收敛：\(\lim_{n\to\infty}P_n^2=\varepsilon^2\)，不是每个 \(n\) 都满足等式。小写 \(r_n\) 是定义 \(P_n=r_n(D+A/n)\) 的正整数乘数；大写 \(R_n=P_{n,1}+P_{n,2}+q\xi\) 是辅助空间 \(Z\) 上的除子，二者不同。
en: The arrow means convergence of numerical self-intersection: \(\lim_{n\to\infty}P_n^2=\varepsilon^2\), not equality for each \(n\). The lowercase \(r_n\) is the positive integer multiplier in \(P_n=r_n(D+A/n)\); the uppercase \(R_n=P_{n,1}+P_{n,2}+q\xi\) is a divisor on the auxiliary space \(Z\). They are different.

zh: 总能选择这样的 \(r_n\)，使 \(P_n^2\to\varepsilon^2\) 吗？请先把它写成一个初步引理。
en: Can we always choose such \(r_n\) so that \(P_n^2\to\varepsilon^2\)? State this first as a preliminary lemma.

verification: 直接展开自交数：D²=0，nef 性给出 D·A≥0，ample 性给出 A²>0；最近整数的误差至多 1/2，因 u_n→0 而消失。此核查只针对初步引理，不包括原文的 jet/Frobenius 估计。
zh: 引理。设 \(X\) 是光滑射影曲面，\(D\) 是 nef Cartier 除子且 \(D^2=0\)，\(A\) 是 ample Cartier 除子。对每个 \(\varepsilon>0\)，存在正整数 \(r_n\to\infty\)，使
\[P_n:=r_n(D+A/n),\qquad P_n^2\longrightarrow\varepsilon^2.\]
证明。令
\[u_n:=\sqrt{(D+A/n)^2}=\sqrt{\frac{2D\cdot A}{n}+\frac{A^2}{n^2}}>0.\]
由 \(D\cdot A\ge0\)、\(A^2>0\) 得到 \(u_n\to0\)。对充分大的 \(n\)，取距离 \(\varepsilon/u_n\) 最近的正整数 \(r_n\)，则
\[|r_nu_n-\varepsilon|\le\frac{u_n}{2}\longrightarrow0,\qquad r_n\longrightarrow\infty.\]
所以
\[P_n^2=(r_nu_n)^2\longrightarrow\varepsilon^2.\]
有限个初始项可以取 \(r_n=1\)。这个初步引理已由上述交数与取整计算核查；不需要 \(K_X\sim0\)，也不需要 \(n(X,D)=2\)。原文的核心喷射估计与 Frobenius 比较仍未完整核查。
en: Lemma. Let \(X\) be a smooth projective surface, \(D\) a nef Cartier divisor with \(D^2=0\), and \(A\) an ample Cartier divisor. For every \(\varepsilon>0\), there exist positive integers \(r_n\to\infty\) such that
\[P_n:=r_n(D+A/n),\qquad P_n^2\longrightarrow\varepsilon^2.\]
Proof. Set
\[u_n:=\sqrt{(D+A/n)^2}=\sqrt{\frac{2D\cdot A}{n}+\frac{A^2}{n^2}}>0.\]
Since \(D\cdot A\ge0\) and \(A^2>0\), we have \(u_n\to0\). For sufficiently large \(n\), choose \(r_n\) to be the nearest positive integer to \(\varepsilon/u_n\). Then
\[|r_nu_n-\varepsilon|\le\frac{u_n}{2}\longrightarrow0,\qquad r_n\longrightarrow\infty.\]
Hence
\[P_n^2=(r_nu_n)^2\longrightarrow\varepsilon^2.\]

For the finitely many initial terms, take \(r_n=1\). This preliminary lemma has been checked by the intersection calculation and rounding estimate above. Neither \(K_X\sim0\) nor \(n(X,D)=2\) is required. The paper’s core jet estimates and Frobenius comparison remain unaudited.

zh: 非常一般点 \(x\) 要随 \(n\) 重新选择吗？
en: Must the very general point \(x\) be chosen again for each \(n\)?

zh: 不需要。对可数多个指标及整数喷射阶的真闭例外集合取并，选取并集之外的同一个 \(x\)，即可同时处理所有指标。这里是非常一般点条件，不是仅删去一个真闭集。
en: No. Take the union of the proper closed exceptional sets for the countably many indices and integral jet orders, then choose the same \(x\) outside that union. This is a very-general-point condition, not merely removal of one proper closed set.

zh: 充分大的阈值 \(N\) 也不依赖点 \(x\)，对吗？
en: Is the threshold \(N\) independent of the point \(x\)?

zh: 陈述要求统一的量词次序：\[\exists N,\{Z_i\}_{i\ge1}\quad\forall x\notin\bigcup_iZ_i\quad\forall n\ge N\quad\forall k\ (kP_n\text{ Cartier})\quad\forall E\in|kP_n|.\]其中 \(N\) 只依赖固定数据与序列；对应的结论为 \(\operatorname{mult}_xE\le4k\sqrt{P_n^2}\)。
en: The statement uses uniform quantifiers: \[\exists N,\{Z_i\}_{i\ge1}\quad\forall x\notin\bigcup_iZ_i\quad\forall n\ge N\quad\forall k\ (kP_n\text{ Cartier})\quad\forall E\in|kP_n|.\]The integer \(N\) depends only on the fixed data and sequence; the conclusion is \(\operatorname{mult}_xE\le4k\sqrt{P_n^2}\).

zh: 主喷射引理要明确 \(X\) 是光滑 K3 曲面，\(D\) 是 nef Cartier 除子且 \(n(X,D)=2\)。
en: State explicitly in the main jet lemma that \(X\) is a smooth K3 surface and \(D\) is nef Cartier with \(n(X,D)=2\).

zh: 保留这些条件，也保留独立假设 \(D^2=0\)；\(n(X,D)=2\) 并不推出 \(D^2=0\)。
en: Retain these hypotheses and the separate assumption \(D^2=0\); nef dimension two does not imply \(D^2=0\).

zh: 使 \(kP_n\) 为 Cartier 的 \(k\) 可以依赖 \(n\) 吗？阈值 \(N\) 和非常一般点 \(x\) 的选择是否统一？
en: Can the integer \(k\) making \(kP_n\) Cartier depend on \(n\)? Are the threshold \(N\) and the very general point \(x\) chosen uniformly?

zh: 可以。\(k=n\) 总能清除 \(P_n=r_n(D+A/n)\) 的分母。阈值 \(N\) 只依赖固定数据 \(X,D,A,\varepsilon,(r_n)\)，不依赖 \(x,k,E\)。
对可数多个 \(n,k\) 和整数喷射阶，将例外的真闭子集取可数并，可得到一个共同的非常一般点集合：其中每个 \(x\) 同时适用于所有 \(n\ge N\)、所有使 \(kP_n\) 为 Cartier 的正整数 \(k\)，以及所有 \(E\in|kP_n|\)。
en: Yes. The choice \(k=n\) always clears the denominators of \(P_n=r_n(D+A/n)\). The threshold \(N\) depends only on the fixed data \(X,D,A,\varepsilon,(r_n)\), not on \(x,k,E\).

Taking the countable union of exceptional proper closed subsets for the countably many \(n,k\) and integral jet orders gives a common very general locus. Every \(x\) in that locus works simultaneously for all \(n\ge N\), every positive integer \(k\) with \(kP_n\) Cartier, and every \(E\in|kP_n|\).

zh: \(\operatorname{ord}_x(s)\) 是极大理想上的阶吗？是不是取 valuation 的负值？
en: Is \(\operatorname{ord}_x(s)\) the order with respect to the maximal ideal? Is it the negative of a valuation?

zh: 在局部标架中写 \(s=f e\)，则 \[\operatorname{ord}_x(s)=\max\{a\ge0:f\in\mathfrak m_x^a\}.\]对正则截面是非负数，不加负号；更换标架只把 \(f\) 乘以单位，不改变阶。曲面上这是点的消失阶，不能直接混同于某个素除子上的离散赋值。
en: In a local frame write \(s=f e\). Then \[\operatorname{ord}_x(s)=\max\{a\ge0:f\in\mathfrak m_x^a\}.\]It is nonnegative for a regular section, with no minus sign. Changing the frame multiplies \(f\) by a unit. On a surface this pointwise vanishing order should not be identified directly with a divisorial discrete valuation.

zh: \(\operatorname{ord}_x(s)\) 怎样定义？线丛截面怎样典范地看成函数？改用线性系中有效除子的重数是否更清楚？
en: How is \(\operatorname{ord}_x(s)\) defined? Can a line-bundle section be viewed canonically as a function? Would the multiplicity of an effective divisor in a linear system be clearer?

zh: 采用除子表述：\(E\in|H|\) 表示有效 Cartier 除子 \(E\sim H\)。若 \(g\) 是 \(E\) 在 \(x\) 处的局部方程，则
\[\operatorname{mult}_x(E)=\max\{a\ge0:g\in\mathfrak m_x^a\}.\]
将 \(g\) 乘以单位不改变这个数。若 \(E=(s)_0\) 是非零截面 \(s\) 的零除子，则 \(\operatorname{mult}_x(E)=\operatorname{ord}_x(s)\)。

固定 Cartier 除子 \(H\) 后，可将 \(\mathcal O_X(H)\) 嵌入函数域，使用满足 \(\operatorname{div}(f)+H\ge0\) 的有理函数 \(f\)。若 \(h\) 是 \(H\) 的局部方程，则零除子的局部方程是 \(fh\)，不是单独的 \(f\)。所以截面阶一般不能直接写成有理函数 \(f\) 的阶。最终用 \(E\in|kP_n|\) 与 \(\operatorname{mult}_x(E)\) 即可，不必另加避开支集的条件。
en: Use divisors: \(E\in|H|\) means an effective Cartier divisor with \(E\sim H\). If \(g\) is a local equation of \(E\) at \(x\), then
\[\operatorname{mult}_x(E)=\max\{a\ge0:g\in\mathfrak m_x^a\}.\]
Multiplying \(g\) by a unit does not change this number. If \(E=(s)_0\) is the zero divisor of a nonzero section \(s\), then \(\operatorname{mult}_x(E)=\operatorname{ord}_x(s)\).

After fixing a Cartier divisor \(H\), one may embed \(\mathcal O_X(H)\) into the function field and use rational functions \(f\) satisfying \(\operatorname{div}(f)+H\ge0\). If \(h\) is a local equation of \(H\), the zero divisor has local equation \(fh\), not \(f\) alone. Thus the section order is not generally the order of the rational function \(f\). The final formulation with \(E\in|kP_n|\) and \(\operatorname{mult}_x(E)\) needs no support-avoidance condition.

zh: 这与 Nakayama 的 \(\sigma\)-分解中的重数相似吗？
en: Is this similar to the multiplicity in Nakayama’s \(\sigma\)-decomposition?

zh: 都涉及重数，但 \(\sigma\) 沿素除子 \(\Gamma\) 取有效代表的下确界。对 big 的 \(\mathbb R\)-除子 \(L\)，
\[\sigma_\Gamma(L)=\inf\{\operatorname{mult}_\Gamma\Delta:\Delta\ge0,\ \Delta\sim_{\mathbb R}L\}.\]
对伪有效 \(L\)，先加 ample 扰动再取极限。我们的引理则是对点 \(x\) 处每个 \(E\in|kP_n|\) 给出重数上界，不能混同。参见 Lazić–Xie (2025), Definition 2.12。
en: Both involve multiplicity, but \(\sigma\) takes an infimum over effective representatives along a prime divisor \(\Gamma\). For a big \(\mathbb R\)-divisor \(L\),
\[\sigma_\Gamma(L)=\inf\{\operatorname{mult}_\Gamma\Delta:\Delta\ge0,\ \Delta\sim_{\mathbb R}L\}.\]

For pseudoeffective \(L\), add an ample perturbation and take the limit. Our lemma instead bounds the multiplicity at a point \(x\) of every \(E\in|kP_n|\) from above. These notions must not be conflated. See Lazić–Xie (2025), Definition 2.12.

en: State the multiplicity bound completely in the surface case.

en: Lemma 2.1 in the current note (before section-based numbering in this exchange). Let \(X\) be a smooth projective K3 surface in characteristic zero, and \(D\) a nef Cartier divisor with
Fix an ample Cartier divisor \(A\) and a positive rational \(\varepsilon\). The later comparison in the paper uses
\[(14\varepsilon)^2<\tfrac14,\qquad80\varepsilon<\tfrac34.\]
Choose positive integers \(r_n\to\infty\) and set
\[P_n=r_n(D+A/n),\qquad P_n^2\longrightarrow\varepsilon^2.\]

Then there exist a positive integer \(N\) and proper closed subsets \(Z_i\subsetneq X\), \(i\ge1\), such that every \(x\in X\setminus\bigcup_iZ_i\) satisfies, simultaneously for every \(n\ge N\), every positive integer \(k\) with \(kP_n\) Cartier, and every effective divisor \(E\in|kP_n|\),

How important are \(14\), \(1/4\), \(3/4\), and \(80\)? Can \(1/4\) be replaced by \(1/8\)?

zh: 重数上界的曲面证明只需要固定的有限 \(\varepsilon>0\)，因而 \(\sqrt{P_n^2}\) 有界，而 \(r_n\to\infty\)。上述小常数条件服务于后续 Frobenius 行列式比较。
若矩阵大小为 \(M\)，秩小于 \(M/4\) 给出消失阶下界 \(3M/4\)，要与上界
\[M\bigl(80\varepsilon+O(1/p)\bigr)\]
竞争；\(80=40+40\)。把 \(1/4\) 换成 \(1/8\) 是更强的充分约束。这里没有声称常数最优，也没有完整核查后续比较。
en: The surface proof of the multiplicity bound only needs a fixed finite \(\varepsilon>0\): then \(\sqrt{P_n^2}\) stays bounded while \(r_n\to\infty\). The small-constant conditions serve the later Frobenius determinant comparison.
For a matrix of size \(M\), rank less than \(M/4\) gives a vanishing-order lower bound \(3M/4\), competing with the upper bound
\[M\bigl(80\varepsilon+O(1/p)\bigr).\]
Here \(80=40+40\). Replacing \(1/4\) by \(1/8\) is a stronger sufficient constraint. No optimality of these constants or full verification of the later comparison is claimed.

zh: 请把原文方法的证明补全，不要只给引理陈述。
en: Please expand the proof following the original method, rather than giving only its statement.

zh: 曲面论证分为孤立基点估计、移动曲线估计及主重数上界；完整证明写入笔记。后面的辅助几何断言和 Frobenius 比较仍须另外核查。

en: Expand the proof of the original method on surfaces.

zh: 以下保留当时的通用阈值写法；后续讨论将其专门化为固定阈值，并简化引理 1.3 的陈述。
先用孤立基点估计 \(h^2\le k^2P^2\)；其线性系中的交数论证在后面说明。第二个输入来自完整喷射核。固定 \(P,k\)，取等距阈值 \(\tau_0<\tau_1<\tau_2\)，间隔 \(\delta>0\)，\(k\delta\ge4\)，并令
\[\mathcal H_i(y)=H^0(X,\mathcal O_X(kP)\otimes\mathfrak m_y^{\lceil k\tau_i\rceil}).\]
假设三个核在非常一般的 \(y\) 非零，最低核的基点集有经过 \(y\) 的曲线。喷射映射的秩在稠密开集上恒定，核构成向量丛；其基点集满足 \(B_0(y)\subseteq B_1(y)\subseteq B_2(y)\)。
在曲面上，真闭集至多一维，所以 \(B_0(y)\) 的一个曲线分支仍是 \(B_1(y)\) 的分支。有限参数域扩张并缩小开集后，得到光滑参数曲面 \(T\)、支配的泛有限标记点映射 \(y:T\to X\)，以及共同基曲线族 \(C_t\)。关联
\[\Gamma=\{(t,z):z\in C_t\}\subset T\times X\]
支配 \(X\)，因为 \(y(t)\in C_t\)。设 \(h=\lceil k\delta/2\rceil\)。较高核 \(\mathcal H_1\) 的局部标架截面可写成
\[s(t,z)=\sum_\alpha c_\alpha(t)s_\alpha(z).\]
固定 \(z\) 作参数求导，仍得到全局截面；每次求导至多降低标记点处一阶消失。对 \(a<h\)，
\[\lceil k\tau_1\rceil-\lceil k\tau_0\rceil\ge k\delta-1\ge h-1\ge a,\]
故这些导数属于 \(\mathcal H_0(y(t))\)，并在 \(\Gamma\) 上消失。

特征零时，在 \(\Gamma\) 的一般光滑点，\(\Gamma\to X\) 是浸没，参数方向张成法方向。取横截参数 \(t_1\)，形式局部坐标中可写 \(u=t_1-F(t_2,z)\)，且固定 \(t_2,z\) 时 \(\partial_{t_1}=\partial_u\)。低于 \(h\) 阶的导数消失，迫使 \(u^a\)、\(a<h\) 的系数全为零，故 \(s\in\mathcal I_\Gamma^h\)。完备化的忠实平坦性将包含关系带回代数局部环。
限制到一般纤维，对整个 \(\mathcal H_1\) 中的截面都有 \(E\ge hC_t\)。因此
\[0<P\cdot C_t\le(k/h)P^2\le(2/\delta)P^2.\]
这就是所需的移动曲线估计，不调用特殊 K3 结果、独立 Riemann–Roch 证明或高维次伴随估计。
en: This retains the general-threshold formulation discussed at that stage; later exchanges specialize the thresholds and simplify Lemma 1.3.

First use the isolated-base-point estimate \(h^2\le k^2P^2\); its intersection argument inside the linear system is explained below. The second input uses the full jet kernels. Fix \(P,k\), take equally spaced levels \(\tau_0<\tau_1<\tau_2\) with gap \(\delta>0\), \(k\delta\ge4\), and set
\[\mathcal H_i(y)=H^0(X,\mathcal O_X(kP)\otimes\mathfrak m_y^{\lceil k\tau_i\rceil}).\]

Assume all three kernels are nonzero for very general \(y\), and the lowest kernel has a base curve through \(y\). Jet evaluation has constant rank on a dense open, so its kernels are vector bundles, with nested base loci \(B_0(y)\subseteq B_1(y)\subseteq B_2(y)\).

A proper closed subset of a surface has dimension at most one, so a curve component of \(B_0(y)\) remains a component of \(B_1(y)\). After a finite parameter-field extension and shrinking, obtain a smooth parameter surface \(T\), a dominant generically finite marked-point map \(y:T\to X\), and a family of common base curves \(C_t\). The incidence
\[\Gamma=\{(t,z):z\in C_t\}\subset T\times X\]
dominates \(X\), since \(y(t)\in C_t\). Set \(h=\lceil k\delta/2\rceil\). A local frame section of the higher kernel \(\mathcal H_1\) has the form
\[s(t,z)=\sum_\alpha c_\alpha(t)s_\alpha(z).\]
Parameter differentiation with \(z\) fixed again gives global sections and lowers vanishing at the moving mark by at most one per derivative. For \(a<h\),
\[\lceil k\tau_1\rceil-\lceil k\tau_0\rceil\ge k\delta-1\ge h-1\ge a.\]
Thus these derivatives belong to \(\mathcal H_0(y(t))\) and vanish along \(\Gamma\).

In characteristic zero, \(\Gamma\to X\) is submersive at a general smooth point, so parameter directions span the normal direction. Choose a transverse parameter \(t_1\). In formal local coordinates, write \(u=t_1-F(t_2,z)\); with \(t_2,z\) fixed, \(\partial_{t_1}=\partial_u\). Vanishing of all derivatives below order \(h\) kills the coefficients of \(u^a\) for \(a<h\), giving \(s\in\mathcal I_\Gamma^h\). Faithful flatness of completion brings this containment back to the algebraic local ring.
Restricting to a general fibre gives \(E\ge hC_t\) for every section of the full \(\mathcal H_1\). Consequently,
\[0<P\cdot C_t\le(k/h)P^2\le(2/\delta)P^2.\]
This is the required moving-curve estimate, without a special K3 result, a separate Riemann–Roch proof, or a higher-dimensional subadjunction estimate.

zh: 以下保留当时的通用阈值写法；后续讨论将其专门化为固定阈值，并简化引理 1.3 的陈述。
若所需上界在任意大的指标处泛性地失败，固定这样的 \(n\)，记 \(P=P_n\)、\(r=r_n\)、\(\rho=\sqrt{P^2}\)。喷射秩条件是代数条件；将违反上界的除子取倍数，可使 \(k\) 任意大且可除。取
\[\delta=\rho,\qquad\tau_0=\tfrac32\rho,\quad\tau_1=\tfrac52\rho,\quad\tau_2=\tfrac72\rho.\]
对充分大可除的 \(k\)，三个完整核非零且 \(k\delta\ge4\)。最低核若只有孤立基点，取 \(h_0=\lceil3k\rho/2\rceil\)，孤立基点估计给出
因此标记点处有基曲线。移动曲线估计给出覆盖曲线族，满足 \(0<P\cdot C\le2\rho\)。选择足够非常一般的标记点，\(n(X,D)=2\) 和 Cartier 性给出 \(D\cdot C\ge1\)，而 \(P-rD=(r/n)A\) nef。因此
\[r\le rD\cdot C\le P\cdot C\le2\rho.\]
这与 \(r_n\to\infty\)、\(\rho_n\to\varepsilon<\infty\) 矛盾。于是存在仅依赖固定数据与序列的统一 \(N\)；对可数多个指标、Cartier 倍数和喷射阶的例外秩集合取并，得到陈述中的共同非常一般点集合。
曲面的两个辅助输入已展开以上证明。一般高维输入和剩余 Frobenius 比较仍未审查；我们尚未证明目标 \(D\equiv E\)、\(E\ge0\)。
en: This retains the general-threshold formulation discussed at that stage; later exchanges specialize the thresholds and simplify Lemma 1.3.

If the required bound fails generically at arbitrarily large indices, fix such an \(n\) and write \(P=P_n\), \(r=r_n\), \(\rho=\sqrt{P^2}\). Jet-rank conditions are algebraic. Taking multiples of a violating divisor makes \(k\) arbitrarily large and divisible. Choose
\[\delta=\rho,\qquad\tau_0=\tfrac32\rho,\quad\tau_1=\tfrac52\rho,\quad\tau_2=\tfrac72\rho.\]
For sufficiently large divisible \(k\), all three full kernels are nonzero and \(k\delta\ge4\). If the lowest kernel had an isolated base point, setting \(h_0=\lceil3k\rho/2\rceil\) would give

by the isolated-base-point estimate. Hence there is a base curve through the mark. The moving-curve estimate gives a covering family with \(0<P\cdot C\le2\rho\). At a sufficiently very general mark, \(n(X,D)=2\) and the Cartier property imply \(D\cdot C\ge1\), while \(P-rD=(r/n)A\) is nef. Therefore
\[r\le rD\cdot C\le P\cdot C\le2\rho.\]

This contradicts \(r_n\to\infty\) and \(\rho_n\to\varepsilon<\infty\). Thus a uniform \(N\) depends only on the fixed data and sequence. Taking the union of exceptional rank loci for countably many indices, Cartier multiples, and jet orders gives the common very general locus in the statement.

The two surface auxiliary inputs have been expanded above. The general higher-dimensional inputs and the remaining Frobenius comparison are still unaudited; our target \(D\equiv E\), \(E\ge0\), has not yet been proved.

zh: 这里的线性系 \(\Lambda\) 起什么作用？为什么不能在全线性系里任取两个除子？如果它的基点并不孤立呢？
en: What role does the linear system \(\Lambda\) play? Why not choose two arbitrary divisors from the complete linear system? What if its base point is not isolated?

zh: 当前笔记的引理 1.2。 设 \(X\) 是光滑射影曲面，\(P\) 是 ample \(\mathbb Q\)-Cartier 除子，\(k,h\) 是正整数，\(kP\) 为 Cartier。设 \(\Lambda\subseteq|kP|\) 是非空线性子系，\(y\) 是其孤立基点，且每个 \(E\in\Lambda\) 都满足 \(\operatorname{mult}_y(E)\ge h\)。则

证明：记 \(F\) 为 \(\Lambda\) 的固定除子部分，取一般的 \(E_1\in\Lambda\)，写成 \(E_1=E_1^{\prime}+F\)。则 \(E_1^{\prime}\) 有效且不含 \(F\) 的分量。因 \(y\) 是孤立基点，\(y\notin\operatorname{Supp}F\)，故 \(\operatorname{mult}_y(E_1^{\prime})=\operatorname{mult}_y(E_1)\ge h\)。
剩余子系 \(\Lambda-F\) 没有固定曲线。故一般的 \(E_2\in\Lambda\) 避开 \(E_1^{\prime}\) 的所有分量，二者正常相交，且 \(\operatorname{mult}_y(E_2)\ge h\)。由局部交数不等式和 \(P\) 的 nef 性，
\[\begin{aligned}h^2&\le\operatorname{mult}_y(E_1^{\prime})\operatorname{mult}_y(E_2)\le i_y(E_1^{\prime},E_2)\\&\le E_1^{\prime}\cdot E_2=kP\cdot E_1^{\prime}\le kP\cdot E_1=k^2P^2.\end{aligned}\]
\(\Lambda\) 提供重数与基点条件；\(E_i\in|kP|\) 提供线性等价类。这里不需要 K3 假设，也不需要 \(K_X\sim0\)。若 \(h>k\sqrt{P^2}\)，非空子系的基点 \(y\) 不可能孤立，因此有经过 \(y\) 的共同基曲线。
应用时，\(\Lambda_y\) 是完整喷射核给出的非空高重数子系。记 \(\rho=\sqrt{P^2}\)，取 \(h=\lceil3k\rho/2\rceil\)。若 \(y\) 孤立，则
\[\tfrac94k^2\rho^2\le h^2\le k^2P^2=k^2\rho^2,\]
矛盾。故这里非孤立是结论，不是前提：标记点处有共同基曲线。随 \(y\) 变化构造曲线族并估计次数，是接下来的移动曲线步骤。
en: Lemma 1.2 in the current note. Let \(X\) be a smooth projective surface, let \(P\) be an ample \(\mathbb Q\)-Cartier divisor, and let \(k,h\) be positive integers with \(kP\) Cartier. Let \(\Lambda\subseteq|kP|\) be a nonempty linear subsystem. Suppose \(y\) is an isolated base point and every \(E\in\Lambda\) satisfies \(\operatorname{mult}_y(E)\ge h\). Then

Proof. Let \(F\) be the fixed divisorial part of \(\Lambda\). Choose a general \(E_1\in\Lambda\) and write \(E_1=E_1^{\prime}+F\). Then \(E_1^{\prime}\) is effective and contains no component of \(F\). Since \(y\) is an isolated base point, \(y\notin\operatorname{Supp}F\), so \(\operatorname{mult}_y(E_1^{\prime})=\operatorname{mult}_y(E_1)\ge h\).

The residual subsystem \(\Lambda-F\) has no fixed curves. A general \(E_2\in\Lambda\) therefore avoids every component of \(E_1^{\prime}\). The two divisors meet properly, and \(\operatorname{mult}_y(E_2)\ge h\). The local intersection inequality and nefness of \(P\) give
\[\begin{aligned}h^2&\le\operatorname{mult}_y(E_1^{\prime})\operatorname{mult}_y(E_2)\le i_y(E_1^{\prime},E_2)\\&\le E_1^{\prime}\cdot E_2=kP\cdot E_1^{\prime}\le kP\cdot E_1=k^2P^2.\end{aligned}\]

The subsystem \(\Lambda\) supplies the multiplicity and base-locus conditions; membership in \(|kP|\) supplies the linear equivalence class. Neither the K3 hypothesis nor \(K_X\sim0\) is needed here. If \(h>k\sqrt{P^2}\), the base point \(y\) of the nonempty subsystem cannot be isolated, so a common base curve passes through \(y\).

In the application, \(\Lambda_y\) is the nonempty high-multiplicity subsystem defined by the full jet kernel. Write \(\rho=\sqrt{P^2}\) and take \(h=\lceil3k\rho/2\rceil\). If \(y\) were isolated, then
\[\tfrac94k^2\rho^2\le h^2\le k^2P^2=k^2\rho^2,\]

a contradiction. Non-isolation is therefore the conclusion, not a premise: there is a common base curve through the mark. Varying \(y\) to construct a curve family and bound its degree is the next moving-curve step.

zh: 这里是原有一般方案在曲面上的展开，并没有换成特殊 K3 定理，对吗？
en: Is this the surface form of the original general method, rather than a replacement using special K3 theorems?

zh: 是。孤立基点与移动曲线步骤只用曲面交数、喷射核及特征零的参数求导；不使用独立 Riemann–Roch 证明。后续原文比较涉及典范条件，不能据此前两步就宣布数值有效性已证。
en: Yes. The isolated-base-point and moving-curve steps use surface intersections, jet kernels and parameter differentiation in characteristic zero, without an independent Riemann–Roch proof. The later comparison uses canonical assumptions; these two steps alone do not establish numerical effectivity.

zh: 证明的第一段究竟要得到什么？
en: What is the first part of the proof intended to establish?

zh: 它证明：非空子系的成员都在 \(y\) 处有重数至少 \(h\)，而 \(y\) 是孤立基点时，必有 \(h^2\le k^2P^2\)。所以 \(h>k\sqrt{P^2}\) 会迫使基点集含经过 \(y\) 的曲线。后面再追踪该曲线并估计次数。
en: It shows that if every member of a nonempty subsystem has multiplicity at least \(h\) at an isolated base point \(y\), then \(h^2\le k^2P^2\). Thus \(h>k\sqrt{P^2}\) forces a base curve through \(y\); the next step tracks that curve and bounds its degree.

zh: base ideal 就是线性系所有局部函数生成的理想吗？
en: Is the base ideal generated by the local functions representing the sections of the linear system?

zh: 是。选取 \(\mathcal O_X(kP)\) 的局部标架，把生成截面写成 \(f_j e\)，基理想为 \((f_j)_j\)，基点集是其零点集。更换标架乘以单位，不改变这个理想；用 \(\Lambda\) 的所有成员或一组生成截面得到相同基理想。
en: Yes. In a local frame of \(\mathcal O_X(kP)\), write generating sections as \(f_j e\). The base ideal is \((f_j)_j\), and its zero locus is the base locus. Changing the frame multiplies the functions by a unit. All members of \(\Lambda\), or any spanning collection of sections, generate the same ideal.

zh: 用线性系表述：每个成员在 \(y\) 的 multiplicity 都至少为 \(h\)。
en: Use the linear-system formulation: every member has multiplicity at least \(h\) at \(y\).

zh: 改写为非空 \(\Lambda\subseteq|kP|\) 及 \(\operatorname{mult}_yE\ge h\)；不把截面直接称为函数。
en: Use a nonempty \(\Lambda\subseteq|kP|\) and \(\operatorname{mult}_yE\ge h\), without calling an abstract section a function.

zh: 把初步引理单列一节，主喷射估计从新的一节开始。
en: Place the preliminary lemmas in their own section and begin the main jet estimates in a new section.

zh: 初步引理为 1.1、1.2、1.3，主估计为 2.1，后接 2.2、2.3；编号与完整证明保持对应。
en: The preliminary lemmas are 1.1, 1.2 and 1.3; the main estimate is 2.1, followed by 2.2 and 2.3. Numbering and complete proofs remain aligned.

zh: 一般的 \(E_1,E_2\) 真能没有公共分量吗？孤立基点是否排除了别处的固定曲线？
en: Can general \(E_1,E_2\) really have no common component? Does an isolated base point rule out fixed curves elsewhere?

zh: 不排除别处的固定曲线。写 \(E_1=E_1^{\prime}+F\)，其中 \(F\) 为固定除子部分，且 \(y\notin\operatorname{Supp}F\)。移动部分无固定曲线，一般 \(E_1^{\prime}\) 不含 \(F\) 的分量，再选一般 \(E_2\) 避开 \(E_1^{\prime}\) 的全部分量。应计算 \(E_1^{\prime}\cdot E_2\)，不能未经去除固定部分就断言 \(E_1,E_2\) 全局正常相交。
en: It does not rule out fixed curves elsewhere. Write \(E_1=E_1^{\prime}+F\), where \(F\) is the fixed divisorial part and \(y\notin\operatorname{Supp}F\). The moving part has no fixed curve; general \(E_1^{\prime}\) contains no component of \(F\), and general \(E_2\) avoids every component of \(E_1^{\prime}\). Compute \(E_1^{\prime}\cdot E_2\), rather than assuming global proper intersection of \(E_1,E_2\) before removing the fixed part.

zh: 去掉固定部分后，\(E_1^{\prime}\) 与 \(E_2\) 没有公共分支；用局部交数非负及整体交数是其和，能否简化证明？
en: After removing the fixed part, \(E_1^{\prime}\) and \(E_2\) have no common component. Can nonnegative local intersections and their sum simplify the proof?

zh: 可以。\[h^2\le\operatorname{mult}_yE_1^{\prime}\operatorname{mult}_yE_2\le i_y(E_1^{\prime},E_2)\le E_1^{\prime}\cdot E_2=kP\cdot E_1^{\prime}\le k^2P^2.\]最后一步一般是 \(\le\)，不是等号；固定部分 \(F\ne0\) 时不能把 \(kP\cdot E_1^{\prime}\) 写成 \(k^2P^2\)。无需另加冗长的吹起论证。
en: Yes. \[h^2\le\operatorname{mult}_yE_1^{\prime}\operatorname{mult}_yE_2\le i_y(E_1^{\prime},E_2)\le E_1^{\prime}\cdot E_2=kP\cdot E_1^{\prime}\le k^2P^2.\]The last comparison is generally \(\le\), not equality: if \(F\ne0\), one cannot identify \(kP\cdot E_1^{\prime}\) with \(k^2P^2\). No lengthy blow-up detour is needed.

zh: \(i_y(E_1,E_2)\) 是在 \(y\) 处的局部交数吗？它与整体交数有什么关系？
en: Is \(i_y(E_1,E_2)\) the local intersection multiplicity at \(y\)? How does it relate to the global intersection number?

zh: 是。若局部方程 \(g_1,g_2\) 没有经过 \(y\) 的公共曲线，则
\[i_y(E_1,E_2)=\operatorname{length}_{\mathcal O_{X,y}}\bigl(\mathcal O_{X,y}/(g_1,g_2)\bigr)\ge\operatorname{mult}_y(E_1)\operatorname{mult}_y(E_2).\]
这个长度有限。对没有公共分量的有效除子，整体交数是所有实际交点处的正局部交数之和；非交点处贡献为零。因此在上面的证明中 \(i_y(E_1^{\prime},E_2)\le E_1^{\prime}\cdot E_2\)。局部交数与整体交数不是同一个数。
en: Yes. If local equations \(g_1,g_2\) have no common curve through \(y\), then
\[i_y(E_1,E_2)=\operatorname{length}_{\mathcal O_{X,y}}\bigl(\mathcal O_{X,y}/(g_1,g_2)\bigr)\ge\operatorname{mult}_y(E_1)\operatorname{mult}_y(E_2).\]

This length is finite. For effective divisors with no common component, the global intersection is the sum of the positive local intersection multiplicities at the actual intersection points; nonintersection points contribute zero. Thus the proof above uses \(i_y(E_1^{\prime},E_2)\le E_1^{\prime}\cdot E_2\). The local and global intersection numbers are distinct.

zh: 把设定移到文章开头即可，不更改假设：特征零，\(X\) 光滑射影曲面，\(K_X\sim0\)，\(D\) nef Cartier，\(n(X,D)=2\)，\(D^2=0\)。
en: Move the setup to the beginning without changing the hypotheses: characteristic zero, \(X\) a smooth projective surface, \(K_X\sim0\), \(D\) nef Cartier, \(n(X,D)=2\), and \(D^2=0\).

zh: 采用最终澄清后的原假设，不把 nef dimension 改成 numerical dimension，也不删掉 \(K_X\sim0\)。光滑曲面上不重复添加“光滑点”限定；初步引理仍只使用各自列明的条件。
en: Retain the hypotheses after the final clarification: do not replace nef dimension by numerical dimension or remove \(K_X\sim0\). Avoid redundant smooth-point qualifiers on a smooth surface; preliminary lemmas use only their explicitly stated assumptions.

zh: 喷射空间能否直接写成满足重数条件的线性子系？
en: Can the jet spaces be written directly as linear subsystems defined by multiplicity conditions?

zh: 可以。写成
\[\Lambda_i(y)=\{E\in|kP|:\operatorname{mult}_y(E)\ge\lceil k\tau_i\rceil\},\qquad i=0,1,2.\]
条件是弱不等式 \(\ge\)，不是 \(>\)。这些子系是相应截面核的射影化，可能为空；引理的假设要求它们在非常一般点处非空。
除子及重数是主要表述，但参数求导仍须使用底层截面核向量丛 \(V_i\) 的截面代表，不能把除子本身当作可线性求导的函数。
en: Yes. Write
\[\Lambda_i(y)=\{E\in|kP|:\operatorname{mult}_y(E)\ge\lceil k\tau_i\rceil\},\qquad i=0,1,2.\]

The condition is the weak inequality \(\ge\), not \(>\). These subsystems are the projectivizations of the corresponding section kernels and may be empty; the lemma assumes they are nonempty at very general points.

Divisors and multiplicities are the primary formulation, but parameter differentiation still uses section representatives from the underlying section-kernel vector bundles \(V_i\). Divisors themselves are not functions that can be linearly differentiated.

zh: 等间隔的条件能否写成公式？\(\tau_i\) 和 \(\delta\) 是整数、有理数，还是实数？
en: Can the equal-gap condition be written as equations? Are \(\tau_i\) and \(\delta\) integers, rational numbers, or real numbers?

zh: 它们是正实数，不必是整数或有理数。准确条件为
\[\tau_0,\tau_1,\tau_2,\delta\in\mathbb R_{>0},\qquad\tau_0<\tau_1<\tau_2,\]
\[\tau_1-\tau_0=\tau_2-\tau_1=\delta,\qquad k\delta\ge4.\]
例如后来取 \(\rho=\sqrt{P^2}\)、\(\delta=\rho\)，以及 \(\tau_0=3\rho/2\)、\(\tau_1=5\rho/2\)、\(\tau_2=7\rho/2\)，这些值可能无理。重数阈值 \(\lceil k\tau_i\rceil\) 才是正整数。
en: They are positive real numbers, not necessarily integers or rational numbers. The precise conditions are
\[\tau_0,\tau_1,\tau_2,\delta\in\mathbb R_{>0},\qquad\tau_0<\tau_1<\tau_2,\]
\[\tau_1-\tau_0=\tau_2-\tau_1=\delta,\qquad k\delta\ge4.\]

For example, the later choices \(\rho=\sqrt{P^2}\), \(\delta=\rho\), \(\tau_0=3\rho/2\), \(\tau_1=5\rho/2\), and \(\tau_2=7\rho/2\) may be irrational. The multiplicity threshold \(\lceil k\tau_i\rceil\) is the positive integer.

zh: 前面的辅助论证究竟证明什么？能否作为独立的移动曲线估计来理解？
en: What does the auxiliary argument establish? Can it be understood as an independent moving-curve estimate?

zh: 以下保留当时的通用阈值写法；后续讨论将其专门化为固定阈值，并简化引理 1.3 的陈述。

它证明移动曲线估计，即引理 1.3。设 \(X\) 为特征零的光滑射影曲面，\(P\) 为 ample \(\mathbb Q\)-Cartier 除子，\(k\) 为正整数且 \(kP\) 为 Cartier。采用上述正实数等间隔阈值，并假设在非常一般的 \(y\) 处，三个 \(\Lambda_i(y)\) 非空，且 \(\operatorname{Bs}\Lambda_0(y)\) 含有经过 \(y\) 的曲线。
经过标记点参数的泛有限扩张并缩小到稠密开集，可得光滑整参数曲面 \(T\)、支配的泛有限映射 \(y:T\to X\)，以及经过 \(y(t)\) 的整曲线族 \(C_t\)，其关联支配 \(X\)。对一般的 \(t\)，每个 \(E\in\Lambda_1(y(t))\) 满足
\[E\ge hC_t,\qquad h=\lceil k\delta/2\rceil,\qquad0<P\cdot C_t\le(k/h)P^2\le2P^2/\delta.\]
追踪共同曲线分量并对截面代表作参数求导，给出沿 \(C_t\) 的重数；再与 ample 除子 \(P\) 相交，得到次数上界。这个辅助估计不要求 K3、\(K_X\sim0\) 或 nef 维数假设；它仍是原有方案的曲面步骤，不能据此宣称数值有效性目标已经证明。
en: This retains the general-threshold formulation discussed at that stage; later exchanges specialize the thresholds and simplify Lemma 1.3.

It proves the moving-curve estimate, Lemma 1.3. Let \(X\) be a smooth projective surface in characteristic zero, let \(P\) be an ample \(\mathbb Q\)-Cartier divisor, and let \(k\) be a positive integer with \(kP\) Cartier. Use the positive real equal-gap thresholds above. Assume that at very general \(y\), all three \(\Lambda_i(y)\) are nonempty and \(\operatorname{Bs}\Lambda_0(y)\) contains a curve through \(y\).

After a generically finite change of the marked-point parameter and restriction to dense opens, there are a smooth integral parameter surface \(T\), a dominant generically finite map \(y:T\to X\), and integral curves \(C_t\) through \(y(t)\) whose incidence dominates \(X\). For general \(t\), every \(E\in\Lambda_1(y(t))\) satisfies
\[E\ge hC_t,\qquad h=\lceil k\delta/2\rceil,\qquad0<P\cdot C_t\le(k/h)P^2\le2P^2/\delta.\]

Tracking a common curve component and differentiating section representatives in the parameters gives the multiplicity along \(C_t\). Intersecting with the ample divisor \(P\) gives the degree bound. This auxiliary estimate needs no K3, \(K_X\sim0\), or nef-dimension hypothesis. It remains a surface step of the original scheme and does not establish the numerical-effectivity target.

zh: 不必引入 \(B_i\) 这个新记号，直接写基点集。
en: Do not introduce the extra shorthand \(B_i\); write the base loci explicitly.

zh: 统一写 \(\operatorname{Bs}\Lambda_i(y)\)，保留线性系与基点集的反向包含关系。
en: Write \(\operatorname{Bs}\Lambda_i(y)\) throughout, preserving the reversed inclusions between systems and their base loci.

zh: 是不是 \(\Lambda_0(y)\) 包含 \(\Lambda_1(y)\)，后者又包含 \(\Lambda_2(y)\)？基点集的包含关系是什么？
en: Does \(\Lambda_0(y)\) contain \(\Lambda_1(y)\), which in turn contains \(\Lambda_2(y)\)? What is the corresponding relation between their base loci?

zh: 是，一般只能写非严格包含。因为
\[\lceil k\tau_0\rceil\le\lceil k\tau_1\rceil\le\lceil k\tau_2\rceil,\qquad\Lambda_0(y)\supseteq\Lambda_1(y)\supseteq\Lambda_2(y).\]
在这些子系非空时，基点集是所有成员支集的交：
\[\operatorname{Bs}\Lambda_i(y)=\bigcap_{E\in\Lambda_i(y)}\operatorname{Supp}(E).\]
提高重数条件会减少允许的成员，因此共同基点集增大，包含关系反向：
\[\operatorname{Bs}\Lambda_0(y)\subseteq\operatorname{Bs}\Lambda_1(y)\subseteq\operatorname{Bs}\Lambda_2(y).\]
en: Yes; the inclusions are generally non-strict. Since
\[\lceil k\tau_0\rceil\le\lceil k\tau_1\rceil\le\lceil k\tau_2\rceil,\qquad\Lambda_0(y)\supseteq\Lambda_1(y)\supseteq\Lambda_2(y).\]
For these nonempty subsystems, the base locus is the intersection of the supports of all members:
\[\operatorname{Bs}\Lambda_i(y)=\bigcap_{E\in\Lambda_i(y)}\operatorname{Supp}(E).\]
Increasing the multiplicity requirement removes permitted members, so their common base locus grows. The inclusions reverse:
\[\operatorname{Bs}\Lambda_0(y)\subseteq\operatorname{Bs}\Lambda_1(y)\subseteq\operatorname{Bs}\Lambda_2(y).\]

zh: 引理 1.3 的陈述太长了，真正需要什么？删掉不必要的结论。
en: Lemma 1.3 is too long. What is actually needed? Remove unnecessary conclusions.

zh: 只需要经过非常一般点的整曲线及其次数上界。参数曲面 \(T\)、曲线族、关联、\(E\ge hC_t\) 等留在完整证明中，不作为陈述的额外结论。
en: Only an integral curve through a very general point and its degree bound are needed. Keep the parameter surface \(T\), curve family, incidence and \(E\ge hC_t\) in the full proof, rather than as additional conclusions in the statement.

zh: 引理 2.1 是否真的需要 \(\tau_0,\tau_1,\tau_2\)？引理 1.3 能否只用 \(\rho\)？
en: Does Lemma 2.1 actually need \(\tau_0,\tau_1,\tau_2\)? Can Lemma 1.3 use only \(\rho\)?

zh: 可以把通用阈值专门化。证明中令 \(\rho=\sqrt{P^2}\)，取足够大的倍数使 \(k\rho\ge4\)，直接定义 \[\Lambda_i(y)=\{E\in|kP|:\operatorname{mult}_yE\ge\lceil(2i+3)k\rho/2\rceil\},\quad i=0,1,2.\]移动曲线次数上界成为 \(2\rho\)，主引理直接调用该结论，不重复引入三个阈值。
en: The general thresholds can be specialized. Set \(\rho=\sqrt{P^2}\) in the proof and take a sufficiently large multiple so that \(k\rho\ge4\). Define directly \[\Lambda_i(y)=\{E\in|kP|:\operatorname{mult}_yE\ge\lceil(2i+3)k\rho/2\rceil\},\quad i=0,1,2.\]The moving-curve bound becomes \(2\rho\), and the main lemma invokes it without introducing the three thresholds again.

zh: 按这个改法，陈述和证明都不要再出现 \(\tau_i\)，直接取固定数值。陈述也可直接写根号，不必再定义 \(\rho\)。
en: Apply this change: remove \(\tau_i\) from the statement and proof and use the fixed values directly. The statement can use the square root without defining \(\rho\).

zh: 完整证明保留，阈值固定为 \(\lceil3k\rho/2\rceil\)、\(\lceil5k\rho/2\rceil\)、\(\lceil7k\rho/2\rceil\)；陈述只保留假设、整曲线及根号形式的次数界。
en: Retain the full proof with thresholds \(\lceil3k\rho/2\rceil\), \(\lceil5k\rho/2\rceil\) and \(\lceil7k\rho/2\rceil\). Keep only the hypotheses, integral curve and square-root degree bound in the statement.

zh: 固定 \(k\) 时，存在 \(E\in|kP|\) 且 \(\operatorname{mult}_yE>4k\sqrt{P^2}\) 的假设，可以把 very general 改为 general 吗？
en: For fixed \(k\), can “very general” be replaced by “general” in the hypothesis that some \(E\in|kP|\) has \(\operatorname{mult}_yE>4k\sqrt{P^2}\)?

zh: 可以，而且这个固定线性系的存在性若对非常一般点成立，就对每一点成立。令 \(q=\lfloor4k\sqrt{P^2}\rfloor+1\)，条件等价于 \((q-1)\)-阶喷射评价映射有非零核。
光滑 \(X\) 上喷射丛局部自由，该秩降低集合是闭集；包含非常一般点的闭集只能是整个 \(X\)。除子 \(E\) 可以随 \(y\) 改变。
这只加强固定 \(k\) 的高重数存在性假设，不把整曲线结论加强成“经过每一点”。对可数多个 \(k\) 的合并问题，仍须注意 general 与 very general 的区别。
en: Yes. For this fixed linear system, existence at a very general point implies existence at every point. Put \(q=\lfloor4k\sqrt{P^2}\rfloor+1\); the condition is equivalent to a nonzero kernel of the \((q-1)\)-jet evaluation map.
On smooth \(X\), the jet bundle is locally free, so the rank-drop locus is closed. If it contains very general points, it is all of \(X\). The divisor \(E\) may vary with \(y\).

This strengthens only the fixed-\(k\) high-multiplicity hypothesis, not the curve conclusion to every point. When combining countably many values of \(k\), the distinction between general and very general still matters.

zh: 引理 1.3 能否直接用 ample Cartier 除子，把原来的 \(k\) 吸收到除子里？
en: Can Lemma 1.3 use an ample Cartier divisor directly, absorbing the original \(k\) into that divisor?

zh: 可以。令 \(H=kP\)，则 \(\sqrt{H^2}=k\sqrt{P^2}\)。对 \(E\in|H|\)、\(\operatorname{mult}_yE>4\sqrt{H^2}\) 得到 \(0<H\cdot C\le2\sqrt{H^2}\)，除以 \(k\) 即恢复 \(0<P\cdot C\le2\sqrt{P^2}\)。证明内部仍须取足够大的整数倍数，不能说全程令 \(k=1\) 而无须调整证明。
en: Yes. Set \(H=kP\), so \(\sqrt{H^2}=k\sqrt{P^2}\). From \(E\in|H|\) and \(\operatorname{mult}_yE>4\sqrt{H^2}\), obtain \(0<H\cdot C\le2\sqrt{H^2}\), then divide by \(k\) to recover \(0<P\cdot C\le2\sqrt{P^2}\). The proof still needs sufficiently large integral multiples internally; one cannot simply set \(k=1\) throughout without adapting it.

zh: 引理 1.3 中改用大写 \(A\)，并假定它是 ample Cartier 除子。
en: Use uppercase \(A\) in Lemma 1.3 and assume it is an ample Cartier divisor.

zh: 最新陈述：设 \(X\) 是特征零的光滑射影曲面，\(A\) ample Cartier；对一般 \(y\in X\)，存在 \(E\in|A|\) 使 \(\operatorname{mult}_yE>4\sqrt{A^2}\)。则经过非常一般点有整曲线 \(C\)，满足 \(0<A\cdot C\le2\sqrt{A^2}\)。证明保留取大倍数 \(|kA|\) 的步骤；引理 2.1 对 \(H=kP_n\) 应用它，再除以 \(k\)。
en: Latest statement: on a smooth projective surface \(X\) in characteristic zero, let \(A\) be ample Cartier. If for general \(y\in X\) there exists \(E\in|A|\) with \(\operatorname{mult}_yE>4\sqrt{A^2}\), then an integral curve \(C\) through a very general point satisfies \(0<A\cdot C\le2\sqrt{A^2}\). The proof retains the large-multiple step in \(|kA|\); Lemma 2.1 applies this to \(H=kP_n\), then divides by \(k\).

zh: 引理 1.3 的结论能从“经过非常一般点”加强为“经过一般点”吗？
en: Can the conclusion of Lemma 1.3 be strengthened from “through a very general point” to “through a general point”?

zh: 可以，但理由不同于固定线性系的喷射秩条件。当前证明给出支配的泛有限映射 \(y:T\to X\)，且 \(y(t)\in C_t\)。缩小到整曲线与次数界成立的非空开集 \(T^\circ\)。
由 Chevalley 定理，\(y(T^\circ)\) 是稠密可构造集，因而包含非空开集 \(U\subset X\)。对每个 \(x\in U\)，可选 \(t\) 满足 \(y(t)=x\)，并得到 \[x\in C_t,\qquad0<A\cdot C_t\le2\sqrt{A^2}.\]
所以曲线结论对一般点成立，仍不是对每一点成立。引理 2.1 需要 nef reduction 的条件，因此在 \(U\) 内继续选非常一般点。
en: Yes, but for a different reason from the fixed-system jet rank condition. The proof gives a dominant generically finite map \(y:T\to X\), with \(y(t)\in C_t\). Restrict to a nonempty open \(T^\circ\) where the fibres are integral and satisfy the degree bound.

By Chevalley’s theorem, \(y(T^\circ)\) is dense and constructible, so it contains a nonempty open \(U\subset X\). For every \(x\in U\), choose \(t\) with \(y(t)=x\), obtaining \[x\in C_t,\qquad0<A\cdot C_t\le2\sqrt{A^2}.\]
The curve conclusion therefore holds at general points, not necessarily every point. Lemma 2.1 still needs the nef-reduction condition, so choose a very general point inside \(U\).

zh: 把引理 1.3 的结论加强为经过一般点，并补上相应证明。
en: Strengthen Lemma 1.3 to a curve through a general point and add the corresponding argument.

zh: 结论改为 through a general point。证明末尾补入 \(T^\circ\) 的稠密可构造像包含非空开集 \(U\) 的论证；引理 2.1 保留在 \(U\) 内选非常一般点，不改变其统一量词。
en: The conclusion now says “through a general point.” The proof ends with the dense constructible image of \(T^\circ\) containing a nonempty open \(U\). Lemma 2.1 retains a very general point inside \(U\), with its uniform quantifiers unchanged.

zh: 笔记开头简洁说明：只研读原文 nef-abundance 证明在光滑曲面情形的展开，并给出原文标题链接；接着写 In this study note, we work over \(\mathbb C\)。删去其他不必要的介绍。
en: Begin with a concise statement that the note studies the smooth surface case of the original nef-abundance proof, linking the paper title. Then write “In this study note, we work over \(\mathbb C\).” Remove the other unnecessary introduction.

zh: 开头保留简短的研读范围、可点击的原文标题和复数域 \(\mathbb C\) 约定，随后是必要的数学设定。已有引理和证明保持不变，未证明命题的状态说明保留。
en: The opening now retains the concise study scope, a clickable original-paper title and the \(\mathbb C\) convention, followed by the necessary mathematical setup. Existing lemmas and proofs are unchanged, and the status of unproved assertions remains explicit.

zh: 标题采用 Nef Abundance: Surface Behavior。开头设 \(X\) 为光滑射影曲面，\(K_X\sim0\)，\(D\) 为 nef Cartier 除子，且 \(D^2=0\)。
en: Use the title Nef Abundance: Surface Behavior. At the beginning let \(X\) be a smooth projective surface with \(K_X\sim0\), and let \(D\) be a nef Cartier divisor with \(D^2=0\).

zh: 采用该标题及开头设定。第二节额外使用 \(n(X,D)=2\)；初步引理仍按各自条件陈述，原有证明及一般点结论保留。
en: The title and opening setup are adopted. Section 2 additionally assumes \(n(X,D)=2\); preliminary lemmas retain their own hypotheses, and the existing proofs and general-point conclusion are preserved.

zh: 引理 1.3 的证明不再引入 \(\rho\)，直接写 \(\sqrt{A^2}\)。
en: Remove \(\rho\) from the proof of Lemma 1.3 and write \(\sqrt{A^2}\) directly.

zh: 将引理 1.3 证明中的 \(\rho\) 全部替换为 \(\sqrt{A^2}\)，保留完整论证与一般点结论。引理 2.1 的 \(\rho\) 记号不变。
en: Every occurrence of \(\rho\) in the proof of Lemma 1.3 is replaced by \(\sqrt{A^2}\), retaining the full argument and general-point conclusion. The \(\rho\) notation in Lemma 2.1 is unchanged.

zh: 引理 1.3 的证明直接写根号，不用 \(\rho\)；开头的 \(q\) 缩写也可以删去。
en: Use the square root directly in the proof of Lemma 1.3, without \(\rho\), and remove the introductory \(q\) abbreviation as well.

zh: 证明已不含 \(\rho\)，现在也删去 \(q\) 缩写，直接使用整数阈值 \(\lfloor4\sqrt{A^2}\rfloor+1\) 说明喷射评价的秩降低条件。后续论证与一般点结论保持不变。
en: The proof already contains no \(\rho\); the \(q\) abbreviation is now removed too. The jet rank-drop condition uses the integer threshold \(\lfloor4\sqrt{A^2}\rfloor+1\) directly. The remaining argument and general-point conclusion are unchanged.

zh: 引理 1.3 证明的第一句话请用严格的数学写清楚，为什么高重数条件是闭的秩降低条件？
en: Please make the first step of Lemma 1.3 mathematically explicit: why is the high-multiplicity condition a closed rank-drop condition?

zh: 对每个 \(y\)，评价映射为 \[\operatorname{ev}_y:H^0(X,\mathcal O_X(A))\longrightarrow\mathcal O_X(A)_y\otimes_{\mathcal O_{X,y}}\bigl(\mathcal O_{X,y}/\mathfrak m_y^{\lfloor4\sqrt{A^2}\rfloor+1}\bigr).\]

对非零截面 \(s\) 及 \(E=(s)_0\)，\[\operatorname{mult}_yE>4\sqrt{A^2}\iff\operatorname{ord}_y(s)\ge\lfloor4\sqrt{A^2}\rfloor+1\iff\operatorname{ev}_y(s)=0.\]因此，存在这样的 \(E\) 等价于 \(\ker\operatorname{ev}_y\ne0\)，即 \(\operatorname{rank}\operatorname{ev}_y<h^0(X,\mathcal O_X(A))\)。
这些映射是全局喷射评价 \[H^0(X,\mathcal O_X(A))\otimes\mathcal O_X\longrightarrow J^{\lfloor4\sqrt{A^2}\rfloor}\mathcal O_X(A)\] 的纤维映射。因 \(X\) 光滑，喷射丛局部自由，秩降低集合局部由矩阵子式定义，是闭集。假设使它包含稠密开集，故它等于 \(X\)。
en: For each \(y\), use the evaluation map \[\operatorname{ev}_y:H^0(X,\mathcal O_X(A))\longrightarrow\mathcal O_X(A)_y\otimes_{\mathcal O_{X,y}}\bigl(\mathcal O_{X,y}/\mathfrak m_y^{\lfloor4\sqrt{A^2}\rfloor+1}\bigr).\]

For a nonzero section \(s\) with \(E=(s)_0\), \[\operatorname{mult}_yE>4\sqrt{A^2}\iff\operatorname{ord}_y(s)\ge\lfloor4\sqrt{A^2}\rfloor+1\iff\operatorname{ev}_y(s)=0.\]Thus existence of such \(E\) is equivalent to \(\ker\operatorname{ev}_y\ne0\), or \(\operatorname{rank}\operatorname{ev}_y<h^0(X,\mathcal O_X(A))\).

These maps are the fibres of global jet evaluation \[H^0(X,\mathcal O_X(A))\otimes\mathcal O_X\longrightarrow J^{\lfloor4\sqrt{A^2}\rfloor}\mathcal O_X(A).\]Smoothness of \(X\) makes the jet bundle locally free. The rank-drop locus is locally defined by matrix minors and is closed. The hypothesis makes it contain a dense open subset, hence it equals \(X\).

zh: 证明每一段开头都简要说明这一段要做什么。
en: Begin each paragraph of the proof with a brief explanation of its purpose.

zh: 引理 1.3 的七段依次说明：扩张高重数假设、迫使出现基曲线、构造曲线族、比较参数导数、得到关联上的重数、推出次数界、得到一般点的开集结论。完整计算保留，不重新引入 q 或 ρ 缩写。
en: The seven paragraphs of Lemma 1.3 now state their goals: extend the high-multiplicity hypothesis, force a base curve, construct the family, compare parameter derivatives, obtain incidence multiplicity, bound the degree, and obtain the conclusion on an open set of general points. Full calculations are retained without reintroducing q or rho abbreviations.

zh: 这个高重数条件能推出对所有点成立吗？
en: Does this high-multiplicity condition hold at every point?

zh: 是。固定线性系与阈值后，满足条件的点集是喷射评价的闭秩降低集合。它包含很一般点的稠密集合，故等于整个曲面。量词是 \(\forall y\in X,\ \exists E_y\)：除子可以随点改变，并不是同一个除子对所有点都具有高重数。关于有界次数曲线的另一条结论仍只断言通过一般点。
en: Yes. For a fixed linear system and threshold, the locus is a closed rank-drop locus of jet evaluation. It contains a dense set of very general points, so it is the whole surface. The quantifiers are \(\forall y\in X,\ \exists E_y\): the divisor may vary with the point. This does not assert that one divisor has high multiplicity at all points. The separate bounded-degree curve conclusion is still only through a general point.

zh: 把这个结论整理成单独的引理，放在原引理前；假设用 very general，结论为所有点。
en: Separate this result into a lemma before the moving-curve lemma, with a very-general hypothesis and an every-point conclusion.

zh: 新引理编号为 1.3，原曲线引理顺延为 1.4；后者引用 1.3，主引理 2.1 的引用同步改为 1.4。各条完整证明保留。
en: The new lemma is 1.3 and the moving-curve lemma becomes 1.4. It invokes 1.3, and the reference in main Lemma 2.1 becomes 1.4. The complete proofs are retained.

zh: 这一步需要 ample 或 \(4\sqrt{A^2}\) 吗？能否改成一个线性系与实数阈值？
en: Does this step need ampleness or \(4\sqrt{A^2}\)? Can it use a linear system and a real threshold?

zh: 不需要正性。设 \(H\) 为 Cartier 除子，固定非空线性子系 \(\Lambda=\mathbb P(V)\subseteq|H|\)，且 \(c\in\mathbb R\)。若很一般点 \(y\) 都存在 \(E_y\in\Lambda\) 满足 \(\operatorname{mult}_yE_y>c\)，则每个点都存在这样的除子。固定同一个 \(V\) 与同一个 \(c\) 是关键。

若 \(c<0\)，有效除子的非负重数已给出结论。若 \(c\ge0\)，限制喷射评价到 \(V\)：\[\operatorname{ev}_y:V\longrightarrow\mathcal O_X(H)_y\otimes_{\mathcal O_{X,y}}\bigl(\mathcal O_{X,y}/\mathfrak m_y^{\lfloor c\rfloor+1}\bigr).\]重数大于 \(c\) 等价于非零核；秩小于 \(\dim V\) 的集合局部由子式定义，因此闭。光滑性保证喷射丛局部自由；在 \(\mathbb C\) 上很一般点集合稠密，故该闭集为 \(X\)。
这只取消喷射引理的 ample 假设与特定数值；曲线引理 1.4 仍需 ample 的 \(A\)，并取 \(H=A\)、\(\Lambda=|A|\)、\(c=4\sqrt{A^2}\) 来应用 1.3。
en: No positivity is needed. Let \(H\) be Cartier, fix a nonempty linear subsystem \(\Lambda=\mathbb P(V)\subseteq|H|\), and let \(c\in\mathbb R\). If for very general \(y\) there is \(E_y\in\Lambda\) with \(\operatorname{mult}_yE_y>c\), such a divisor exists at every point. Fixing the same \(V\) and the same \(c\) is essential.

For \(c<0\), nonnegative multiplicity of effective divisors proves the claim. For \(c\ge0\), restrict jet evaluation to \(V\): \[\operatorname{ev}_y:V\longrightarrow\mathcal O_X(H)_y\otimes_{\mathcal O_{X,y}}\bigl(\mathcal O_{X,y}/\mathfrak m_y^{\lfloor c\rfloor+1}\bigr).\]Multiplicity greater than \(c\) is equivalent to a nonzero kernel. The locus of rank less than \(\dim V\) is locally defined by minors, hence closed. Smoothness makes the jet bundle locally free; very general points are dense over \(\mathbb C\), so the closed locus is \(X\).

This removes ampleness and the special numerical threshold only from the jet lemma. The moving-curve Lemma 1.4 still needs ample \(A\) and applies 1.3 with \(H=A\), \(\Lambda=|A|\), \(c=4\sqrt{A^2}\).

zh: 新引理用固定线性系与任意实数 c；不要限定为四倍根号 A 平方。
en: State the new lemma for a fixed linear system and any real number c, without the special four-square-root threshold.

zh: 引理 1.3 已按此一般形式表述，包含负阈值情形与完整喷射秩证明；1.4 保留其原有正性条件与次数界。
en: Lemma 1.3 now has this general formulation, including the negative-threshold case and the full jet-rank proof. Lemma 1.4 retains its original positivity hypothesis and degree bound.

zh: 1.4 的条件改成每个点成立，这样 1.4 就不需要引用 1.3。
en: Assume the multiplicity condition at every point in 1.4, so its proof need not invoke 1.3.

zh: 1.4 现直接假设每个点存在高重数除子；其证明不再调用 1.3。主引理 2.1 先用 1.3 把很一般点的条件推广到每个点，再用 1.4 得到曲线次数界。
en: Lemma 1.4 now directly assumes a high-multiplicity divisor at every point, and its proof no longer calls 1.3. Main Lemma 2.1 first uses 1.3 to extend the condition from very general points to every point, then applies 1.4 for the curve degree bound.

zh: 那个映射叫 jet evaluation 吗？1.3 能不用评价映射，直接用重数证明吗？
en: Is that map called jet evaluation? Can 1.3 be proved directly using multiplicity without evaluation maps?

zh: 是，先前的映射是 jet evaluation。\(H^0\) 在那里表示全局截面空间，并不是借助某个上同调消失定理。不过可以完全改用点与除子的关联闭集。

若 \(c<0\)，任意有效除子的非负重数给出结论。若 \(c\ge0\)，令 \[Z=\{(y,E)\in X\times\Lambda:\operatorname{mult}_yE>c\}.\]局部写通用除子方程 \(f(u,v,E)\)，在光滑曲面的 étale 坐标中，特征零的 Taylor 展开给出 \[\operatorname{mult}_yE>c\iff\partial_u^a\partial_v^bf(y,E)=0\quad(a,b\ge0,\ a+b\le\lfloor c\rfloor).\]这些有限阶偏导是正则函数，因此给出局部闭条件。换方程乘以单位、换正则参数都保持消失阶，故这些闭集粘合为 \(Z\)。
固定线性系 \(\Lambda\) 是射影参数空间，所以投影 \(p:X\times\Lambda\to X\) proper，\(p(Z)\) 闭。它包含在 \(\mathbb C\) 上稠密的很一般点集合，故 \(p(Z)=X\)。因此 \(\forall y\in X,\ \exists E_y\in\Lambda\) 满足重数条件，除子仍可以随点变化。
en: Yes, the earlier map is jet evaluation. There \(H^0\) denotes the space of global sections; the argument did not invoke a cohomological vanishing theorem. It can nevertheless be replaced entirely by an incidence locus of points and divisors.

For \(c<0\), nonnegative multiplicity of effective divisors proves the result. For \(c\ge0\), set \[Z=\{(y,E)\in X\times\Lambda:\operatorname{mult}_yE>c\}.\]Locally write the universal divisor equation as \(f(u,v,E)\). In étale coordinates on the smooth surface, characteristic-zero Taylor expansion gives \[\operatorname{mult}_yE>c\iff\partial_u^a\partial_v^bf(y,E)=0\quad(a,b\ge0,\ a+b\le\lfloor c\rfloor).\]These finitely many derivatives are regular functions, hence define a local closed locus. Multiplication by a unit and changes of regular parameters preserve vanishing order, so the loci glue to \(Z\).

The fixed linear system \(\Lambda\) is projective, so the projection \(p:X\times\Lambda\to X\) is proper and \(p(Z)\) is closed. It contains a dense very-general locus over \(\mathbb C\), hence \(p(Z)=X\). Thus \(\forall y\in X,\ \exists E_y\in\Lambda\) with the required multiplicity, and the divisor may still vary with the point.

zh: 1.3 的证明不要用评价映射，直接证明。
en: Prove 1.3 directly, without evaluation maps.

zh: 1.3 已改为局部方程与有限阶偏导证明关联集合闭，再由射影投影的闭像得到所有点；完整保留负阈值情形，不使用 H⁰、评价映射或喷射丛记号。
en: The proof of 1.3 now uses local equations and finitely many derivatives to show the incidence locus is closed, then uses the closed image of the projective projection to obtain every point. The negative-threshold case remains; H⁰, evaluation maps and jet-bundle notation are removed.

zh: 把引理 1.3 的通用有效 Cartier 除子记为花体 \(\mathcal H\)，与线性系中的 \(H\) 对应。
en: Denote the universal effective Cartier divisor in Lemma 1.3 by \(\mathcal H\), corresponding to \(H\) in the linear system.

zh: 通用有效 Cartier 除子已记为 \(\mathcal H\)。
en: The universal effective Cartier divisor is now denoted by \(\mathcal H\).

zh: 这里的局部坐标就是光滑点局部环的极大理想的最小生成元。它们是函数芽，正特征下也能选；是否不需要额外选取 étale 邻域？
en: Local coordinates here are minimal generators of the maximal ideal of the local ring at a smooth point. They are function germs and also exist in positive characteristic. Is an additional choice of an étale neighbourhood unnecessary?

zh: 对。在光滑曲面的闭点 \(y\)，选正则参数 \(\mathfrak m_y=(u,v)\) 即可。把函数芽延伸到开邻域并缩小后，坐标映射 \((u,v)\) 自动为 étale；这是光滑性的结果，不是额外选取条件。此前把二者说成不同选择的措辞不准确。
正特征下同样有正则参数。依赖特征零的是用普通偏导判定所有低次系数的步骤，例如特征 \(p\) 下 \(u^p\) 的正阶普通偏导全为零。
en: Yes. At a closed point \(y\) of a smooth surface, choose regular parameters \(\mathfrak m_y=(u,v)\). Extend these function germs to an open neighbourhood and shrink it; the coordinate map \((u,v)\) is then automatically étale by smoothness. This is not an additional choice. The earlier wording incorrectly presented these as distinct choices.

Regular parameters also exist in positive characteristic. Characteristic zero is needed for the ordinary-derivative criterion for all low-degree coefficients: for example, in characteristic \(p\), all positive-order ordinary derivatives of \(u^p\) vanish.

zh: \(f\) 是除子的局部方程。为什么 \(\operatorname{mult}_y(E)>c\) 当且仅当相应的低阶偏导值为零？
en: \(f\) is the local equation of the divisor. Why is \(\operatorname{mult}_y(E)>c\) equivalent to vanishing of the corresponding low-order derivative values?

zh: 在 \(y\) 处的中心参数中写 \(f_E=\sum\lambda_{ab}u^av^b\)。重数是最低非零项的总次数，因此 \(\operatorname{mult}_y(E)>c\) 当且仅当 \(a+b\le\lfloor c\rfloor\) 的系数全部为零。
特征零下，对应偏导在 \(y\) 的值是 \(a!b!\lambda_{ab}\)，所以系数消失等价于偏导值消失。零阶条件就是 \(f_E(y)=0\)。
en: In parameters centred at \(y\), write \(f_E=\sum\lambda_{ab}u^av^b\). Multiplicity is the lowest total degree of a nonzero term. Thus \(\operatorname{mult}_y(E)>c\) is equivalent to vanishing of all coefficients with \(a+b\le\lfloor c\rfloor\).
In characteristic zero the corresponding derivative value at \(y\) is \(a!b!\lambda_{ab}\), so coefficient vanishing is equivalent to derivative vanishing. The order-zero condition is \(f_E(y)=0\).

zh: 把线性系的参数坐标写出来，直接用局部展开中低次项系数为零表达重数条件，不用偏导。
en: Write the parameter coordinates of the linear system and express the multiplicity condition directly by vanishing of low-degree coefficients in the local expansion, without derivatives.

zh: 引理 1.3 已改用通用局部方程和低次系数的消失来证明关联集合闭。
en: Lemma 1.3 now proves closedness of the incidence locus using the universal local equation and vanishing of low-degree coefficients.

zh: 因为是线性系，所以参数坐标只能以一次项出现，对吗？
en: Because this is a linear system, do the parameter coordinates occur only linearly?

zh: 对。齐次参数下，所选通用方程是 \(\sum t_i f_i\)，对参数齐次一次；仿射图上则是仿射线性。这只约束参数次数，曲面局部坐标的展开仍可有高次项，而且 \(f_i\) 一般是正则函数，并不一定是局部坐标的多项式。
en: Yes. In homogeneous parameters, the chosen universal equation is \(\sum t_i f_i\), homogeneous of degree one in the parameters; on an affine chart it is affine linear. This constrains parameter degree only. The expansion in the surface coordinates may have higher-degree terms, and the \(f_i\) are generally regular functions, not necessarily polynomials in those coordinates.

zh: 固定 \(y\)，除子在 \(y\) 处的重数对应局部方程关于 \(u,v\) 的什么次数？
en: At a fixed point \(y\), which degree in \(u,v\) of the local equation gives the multiplicity of the divisor?

zh: 是最低非零项的总次数，即消失阶。经过 \(y\) 意味着常数项为零；重数至少三意味着零次、一次和二次项的系数全部为零。重数恰好三还要求三次项的系数至少一个非零。
en: It is the lowest total degree of a nonzero term, namely the vanishing order. Passing through \(y\) means that the constant term vanishes. Multiplicity at least three means that all degree-zero, degree-one and degree-two coefficients vanish; multiplicity exactly three also requires at least one nonzero degree-three coefficient.

zh: 写出 \(f\) 后直接给出 \(Z\) 的定义方程：总次数不超过 \(\lfloor c\rfloor\) 的系数全部为零。删去长解释。
en: After writing \(f\), give the defining equations of \(Z\) directly: all coefficients of total degree at most \(\lfloor c\rfloor\) vanish. Remove the long explanation.

zh: 已用这些低次系数的消失直接写出局部方程。每个开图内都是闭集，因此 \(Z\) 在整个乘积中是闭的。
en: The local equations are now given directly by vanishing of these low-degree coefficients. The locus is closed on each open chart, hence \(Z\) is closed in the entire product.

zh: 引理 1.3 的点改记为小 \(x\)。局部参数以该点为中心，不用再写坐标差；表述继续精简。
en: Denote the point in Lemma 1.3 by \(x\). Use local parameters centred at the point without writing coordinate differences, and keep the wording concise.

zh: 点已记为 \(x\)，参数坐标用 \(t_i\)，局部展开使用以 \(x\) 为中心的参数。
en: The point is now denoted by \(x\), the parameter coordinates by \(t_i\), and the local expansion uses parameters centred at \(x\).

zh: \(t_i\) 取齐次坐标，方程直接写成 \(\sum t_i f_i\)，不单列 \(f_0\)。
en: Take the \(t_i\) to be homogeneous coordinates and write the equation as \(\sum t_i f_i\), without a separate \(f_0\) term.

zh: 通用方程及系数方程均已改成齐次求和形式。
en: Both the universal equation and the coefficient equations now use homogeneous sums.

zh: 系数改记为 \(c_{i,ab}\)，下标保留；重数阈值改用实数 \(r\)。不用另引入 \(B_{ab}\)，直接写 \(\sum t_i c_{i,ab}(x)=0\)。
en: Denote the coefficients by \(c_{i,ab}\), keeping the indices, and use a real number \(r\) for the multiplicity threshold. Do not introduce \(B_{ab}\); write \(\sum t_i c_{i,ab}(x)=0\) directly.

zh: 引理 1.3 不必假设对很一般点成立。改成存在 Zariski 稠密子集 \(S\subseteq X\)，对每个 \(x\in S\) 都有 \(E_x\in\Lambda\) 满足 \(\operatorname{mult}_x(E_x)>r\)。
en: Lemma 1.3 need not assume the condition at very general points. Instead, assume that there is a Zariski dense subset \(S\subseteq X\) such that every \(x\in S\) admits \(E_x\in\Lambda\) with \(\operatorname{mult}_x(E_x)>r\).

zh: 这一条件足够。\(Z\) 的局部方程为 \(\sum_{i=0}^{m}t_i c_{i,ab}(x)=0\)，其中 \(a+b\le\lfloor r\rfloor\)，故 \(Z\) 闭。射影投影给出闭集 \(p(Z)\)，它包含稠密子集 \(S\)，因此 \(p(Z)=X\)。
en: This condition suffices. The local equations of \(Z\) are \(\sum_{i=0}^{m}t_i c_{i,ab}(x)=0\) for \(a+b\le\lfloor r\rfloor\), so \(Z\) is closed. Projective projection gives a closed set \(p(Z)\), which contains the dense subset \(S\); hence \(p(Z)=X\).

zh: 证明开头只写“We may assume \(r\ge0\)”。结尾在“假设说明 \(p(Z)\) 包含 \(S\)，故 \(p(Z)=X\)”处结束，不再重复结论。
en: Begin the proof simply with “We may assume \(r\ge0\).” End with “The hypothesis says that \(p(Z)\) contains \(S\), and hence \(p(Z)=X\),” without repeating the conclusion.

zh: 引理 1.2 不用单独引入 \(k\)：把 \(kP\) 作为整体记为 \(H\)，结论写成 \(h^2\le H^2\)。
en: Lemma 1.2 need not introduce \(k\) separately: denote the Cartier divisor \(kP\) by \(H\), and write the conclusion as \(h^2\le H^2\).

zh: 引理 1.2 是否只需要 \(H\) nef，不需要 ample？
en: Does Lemma 1.2 require only that \(H\) be nef, rather than ample?

zh: 是。令 \(F\) 为有效固定部分，选 \(E_1=E_1^{\prime}+F\) 和与 \(E_1^{\prime}\) 无共同分量的一般成员 \(E_2\in\Lambda\)。孤立基点不在 \(F\) 上，所以局部交数给出 \[h^2\le i_x(E_1^{\prime},E_2)\le E_1^{\prime}\cdot H=H^2-H\cdot F\le H^2.\]最后一步只用到 nef 性与 \(F\ge0\)。因此条件可改为 nef Cartier 除子 \(H\)，结论为 \(h^2\le H^2\)。
en: Yes. Let \(F\) be the effective fixed part. Choose \(E_1=E_1^{\prime}+F\) and a general \(E_2\in\Lambda\) sharing no component with \(E_1^{\prime}\). The isolated base point lies outside \(F\), so local intersection gives \[h^2\le i_x(E_1^{\prime},E_2)\le E_1^{\prime}\cdot H=H^2-H\cdot F\le H^2.\]The final step uses only nefness and \(F\ge0\). Thus the hypothesis can be a nef Cartier divisor \(H\), with conclusion \(h^2\le H^2\).

zh: 引理 1.2 的重数阈值是否不必是正整数，可以像 1.3 一样改用实数 \(r\)？
en: Can the multiplicity threshold in Lemma 1.2 be a real number \(r\), as in 1.3, rather than a positive integer?

zh: 整数条件不必要，非负实数 \(r\) 就够：由 \(\operatorname{mult}_x(E_i)\ge r\ge0\) 得到相同的交数界 \(r^2\le H^2\)。不能允许任意负数，因为结论含平方。例如 \(\mathbb P^2\) 上经过固定点的直线束，\(H^2=1\)，取 \(r=-2\) 时重数条件成立，但 \(r^2\le H^2\) 不成立。用户确认保留 \(r\ge0\)。
en: Integrality is unnecessary: a nonnegative real \(r\) suffices. The inequalities \(\operatorname{mult}_x(E_i)\ge r\ge0\) give the same intersection bound \(r^2\le H^2\). Arbitrary negative values are inadmissible because the conclusion involves a square. For the pencil of lines through a fixed point in \(\mathbb P^2\), \(H^2=1\); taking \(r=-2\) satisfies the multiplicity condition but not \(r^2\le H^2\). The user confirmed retaining \(r\ge0\).

zh: 把引理 1.3 的结论补完整：对每个 \(x\in X\)，存在除子 \(E_x\in\Lambda\)，使得 \(\operatorname{mult}_x(E_x)>r\)。
en: Complete the conclusion of Lemma 1.3: for every \(x\in X\), there exists a divisor \(E_x\in\Lambda\) such that \(\operatorname{mult}_x(E_x)>r\).

zh: 能否把引理 1.4 的重数阈值 \(4\sqrt{A^2}\) 改成任意实数 \(r\)，同时把曲线交数界改成 \(A\cdot C\le2r\)？
en: Can Lemma 1.4 use an arbitrary real multiplicity threshold \(r\) instead of \(4\sqrt{A^2}\), with curve-degree bound \(A\cdot C\le2r\)?

zh: 前人是否研究过引理 1.4 这种从高重数推出低交数曲线的问题？
en: Has earlier work studied the passage from high multiplicity to curves of bounded degree appearing in Lemma 1.4?

zh: 最初找到的是 EKL 的 Proposition 2.3 和 Nakamaye 2004 的 Lemma 1.3。它们提供参数微分与消失阶估计，尚未直接比较曲线存在的最终结论。后面的讨论进一步修正了这个文献比较。
en: The initial references were EKL Proposition 2.3 and Nakamaye 2004 Lemma 1.3. They provide parameter differentiation and vanishing-order estimates; the final curve-existence conclusion had not yet been compared. The subsequent discussion refines this comparison.

zh: 这些文献的具体命题如何表述？
en: What are the precise statements in these references?

zh: EKL 的 Proposition 2.3 对覆盖族 \(Z\subseteq V\subseteq X\times T\) 构造同一线性系中的新除子，去掉 \(V\) 并保留至少 \(\operatorname{mult}_Z(E)-\operatorname{mult}_V(E)\) 的重数。Nakamaye 的 Lemma 1.3 将其写成沿基子簇的消失阶下界。这些首先是工具性命题。
en: EKL Proposition 2.3 constructs a divisor in the same linear series avoiding \(V\) while retaining multiplicity at least \(\operatorname{mult}_Z(E)-\operatorname{mult}_V(E)\), for a covering incidence \(Z\subseteq V\subseteq X\times T\). Nakamaye Lemma 1.3 expresses this as a lower bound for vanishing along a base subvariety. These are primarily technical inputs.

zh: 这些命题分析的是消失阶之间的关系；我们的 1.4 则断言存在一条交数有上界的曲线。结论层面并不一样。
en: These statements compare vanishing orders, whereas our Lemma 1.4 asserts existence of a curve with bounded intersection number. The conclusions are different.

zh: 是否可以据此说 1.4 的结论前人没有证明过？
en: Can we therefore say that the conclusion of Lemma 1.4 has not been proved before?

zh: 不能。进一步核对 Nakamaye 2003 的 Theorem 2 证明：令 \(\varepsilon=\varepsilon(A,\eta)\)，选有理数 \(q\) 满足 \(\varepsilon<q<\operatorname{mult}_\eta(E)/2\)，则 \(A/q\) 的 Seshadri 常数小于一，且有效数值代表 \(E/q\) 的重数大于二。该证明构造在 \(\eta\) 光滑的 Seshadri exceptional 曲线，从而 \(A\cdot C=\varepsilon\le\sqrt{A^2}\)。这是从其证明得到的曲面推论，比 1.4 的交数界更强；它不替代我们随后要求的高维证明路线。
en: No. The proof of Nakamaye 2003 Theorem 2 applies after choosing rational \(q\) with \(\varepsilon(A,\eta)<q<\operatorname{mult}_\eta(E)/2\). Then \(A/q\) has Seshadri constant below one and effective numerical representative \(E/q\) has multiplicity above two. That proof constructs a Seshadri-exceptional curve smooth at \(\eta\), giving \(A\cdot C=\varepsilon(A,\eta)\le\sqrt{A^2}\). This surface consequence of the proof is stronger than Lemma 1.4, but does not replace the subsequently prescribed higher-dimensional route.

zh: 1.4 中取系数二，是否是为了高维推广？
en: Was the coefficient two in Lemma 1.4 chosen for a higher-dimensional extension?

zh: 当前曲面稿中的二来自取 \(h=\lceil k\sqrt{A^2}/2\rceil\)，再由 \(E\ge hC\) 得 \(A\cdot C\le(k/h)A^2\le2\sqrt{A^2}\)。它是这一重数估计中的宽松常数，并非已经建立的高维结论。
en: The current surface coefficient comes from \(h=\lceil k\sqrt{A^2}/2\rceil\): the inequality \(E\ge hC\) yields \(A\cdot C\le(k/h)A^2\le2\sqrt{A^2}\). It is a conservative constant in this multiplicity estimate, not an already established higher-dimensional conclusion.

zh: 必须保留原始高维证明路线，二维只是展示它在曲面上的表现。所用的每个引理都应有可用的高维版本。
en: Keep the original higher-dimensional proof route, using dimension two only to display its surface behavior. Every lemma used must have an applicable higher-dimensional version.

zh: 曲面上基曲线是除子，可以用它在有效除子中的系数控制交数；高维基 locus 可能有更高余维，需要以普通理想幂和局部交重数重建这一步。EKL 的参数微分适用于高维，后续交数接口仍须补齐。
en: On a surface a base curve is a divisor, so its coefficient in an effective divisor controls its degree. A higher-dimensional base locus can have larger codimension; the corresponding step must use ordinary ideal powers and local intersection multiplicities. EKL parameter differentiation applies in higher dimension, but the intersection interface must be supplied.

zh: 请补上这些高维对应步骤。
en: Supply these higher-dimensional counterparts.

zh: 三维部分在复数域上聚焦于光滑射影 Calabi–Yau 三维簇，满足 \(K_X\sim0\) 和 \(q(X)=0\)，并展示原始高维证明在此情形中的具体形式。
en: Focus the threefold study over the complex numbers on smooth projective Calabi–Yau threefolds with \(K_X\sim0\) and \(q(X)=0\), displaying the original higher-dimensional argument in this setting.

zh: 只需要证明 non-vanishing，即某个正整数倍 \(mD\) 有非零截面。不必要的后续技术不在这里展开。
en: The only target is nonvanishing: some positive multiple \(mD\) has a nonzero section. Do not expand techniques needed only for stronger subsequent conclusions.

zh: 目标是存在正整数 \(m\) 使 \(H^0(X,mD)\ne0\)。在 \(q(X)=0\) 下，若得到有效的有理数值代表，可以通过正整数倍转为所需截面；jet 和 Frobenius 部分只保留非消失所需的内容。
en: The target is \(H^0(X,mD)\ne0\) for some positive integer \(m\). With \(q(X)=0\), an effective rational numerical representative can be converted, after a positive multiple, into the required section. Retain only the jets and Frobenius arguments needed for nonvanishing.

zh: 直接以 Theorem 开篇：\(X\) 是光滑射影三维簇，\(K_X\sim0\)、\(q(X)=0\)，\(D\) 是 nef Cartier 除子，结论是某个正整数倍有非零截面。后续引理统一使用这个设定，第二节再引入约化。
en: Open directly with a theorem: \(X\) is a smooth projective threefold with \(K_X\sim0\) and \(q(X)=0\), and \(D\) is nef Cartier; the conclusion is a nonzero section of some positive multiple. Use this setting throughout the lemmas and introduce reductions in Section 2.

zh: 文稿已按此结构重排，只以 non-vanishing 为目标；当时的第二节先处理 \(\nu(D)=0,3\)，再讨论 \(\nu(D)=1,2\)，并标出尚未闭合的步骤。
en: The draft was reorganized around nonvanishing. At this stage Section 2 treated \(\nu(D)=0,3\) before discussing \(\nu(D)=1,2\), with unfinished steps identified.

zh: 证明还不完整？
en: Is the proof still incomplete?

zh:
当时确实不完整：\(
u(D)=0,3\) 的分支已有处理，但 \(
u(D)=1\) 只有标量估计，\(
u(D)=2\) 的曲面分支、七维 jet 构造、Frobenius 比较以及较小 nef 维数的下降仍有缺口。不能把尚未建立的输入直接当作已证引理。
en:
It was incomplete at this point. The branches \(
u(D)=0,3\) had been treated, but \(
u(D)=1\) had only a scalar estimate; the surface branch for \(
u(D)=2\), the sevenfold jet construction, the Frobenius comparison, and descent for smaller nef dimension still had gaps. Inputs not yet established could not be treated as proved lemmas.

zh: 仔细阅读原文，补齐这些缺口。
en: Read the original manuscript carefully and fill these gaps.

zh: 对照原文后，草稿补入了曲面模型上的 \(K_{\widetilde V}\cdot P_{\widetilde V}\) 界，并利用 Birkar–Zhang 的有界次数输入处理 \(\nu(D)=2\) 分支。这条草稿路线没有把 \(D\cdot c_2(X)>0\) 添加为假设；具体适用性仍需核查，引用编号也须区分原稿与伴随稿。
en: After comparison with the source, the draft supplied a bound for \(K_{\widetilde V}\cdot P_{\widetilde V}\) on the surface model and used the Birkar–Zhang bounded-degree input in the \(\nu(D)=2\) branch. This draft route did not add \(D\cdot c_2(X)>0\) as a hypothesis. Applicability still requires checking, and references must distinguish the main manuscript from its companion.

zh: Frobenius 比较的草稿主线是：泛点秩为 \(p^6\)，对角线秩小于 \(p^6/4\)，因此行列式除子在对角点的重数大于 \(3p^6/4\)；可动曲线见证给出同一重数的上界。两者需要在固定的几何输入上比较。
en: The draft Frobenius comparison has generic rank \(p^6\) and diagonal rank less than \(p^6/4\), forcing the determinant divisor to have multiplicity greater than \(3p^6/4\) at the diagonal point. A movable-curve witness bounds that same multiplicity above. Both estimates must use fixed geometric inputs.

zh: 下降、曲面分支和行列式比较已在修订稿中展开，但这是依赖所引预印本的证明草稿，不能据此宣布已经独立验证三维 nef non-vanishing。
en: The revised draft expanded descent, the surface branch, and the determinant comparison. It remains a proof draft dependent on the cited preprint; this does not establish independently verified threefold nef nonvanishing.

zh: 现在还缺什么？继续补上；所需引理材料在已有资料库中。
en: What remains missing? Continue filling the gaps using the available lemma materials.

zh: 七维构造当时仍主要依赖引用与概述，需要把移动基分量的各个情形展开，核对切片、纤维限制、有限覆盖和对应的接口。
en: The sevenfold construction still relied mainly on citation and a sketch. The cases of moving base components needed expansion, including the interfaces for slices, fiber restrictions, finite covers, and correspondences.

zh: 纤维限制需要真正的普通理想幂包含 \(\mathfrak b\subset I_V^h\)，不能仅以泛点消失阶替代。有限覆盖步骤还需固定覆盖次数并控制分支补集；双有理修改后要重新安排图的平坦性。
en: Fiber restriction needs an actual inclusion into an ordinary ideal power, \(\mathfrak b\subset I_V^h\), rather than just a generic vanishing order. The finite-cover step also needs a fixed covering degree and control of the branch complement; flatness of the graph must be arranged again after birational modification.

zh: 草稿进一步写出了普通理想幂、纤维限制、切片、多截面、分支与有限覆盖，以及阿贝尔模型的对应步骤。辅助的 big 分支使用已发表的三维 MMP 与曲面输入；这些细节写出后，仍需逐一核对假设和推导。
en: The draft further wrote out ordinary ideal powers, fiber restrictions, slices, multisections, branch and finite-cover arguments, and the correspondence on an abelian model. The auxiliary big branch uses published threefold MMP and surface inputs. Writing these steps out still leaves their hypotheses and deductions to be checked.

zh: 现在证明完整了吗？
en: Is the proof complete now?

zh: 当时的回复是“书面证明草稿已经补齐”，而不是正确性已获认证。泛点 subadjunction、两个 adjoint MMP 和七维 jet 构造仍是需要独立核查的重点。完整的书面草稿与已经验证的证明应区分。
en: The reply at this stage meant that the written proof draft had been filled out, rather than that correctness was certified. Generic subadjunction, the two adjoint MMPs, and the sevenfold jet construction remained priorities for independent checking. A filled-out written draft and a verified proof must be distinguished.

zh: 把研究范围直接加进定理本身：\(X/\mathbb C\) 光滑射影，\(\dim X=3\)、\(K_X\sim0\)、\(q(X)=0\)，\(D\) nef Cartier，且 \(n(X,D)=3\)、\(D^3=0\)。
en: Put the scope directly into the theorem: \(X/\mathbb C\) smooth projective, \(\dim X=3\), \(K_X\sim0\), \(q(X)=0\), and \(D\) nef Cartier with \(n(X,D)=3\) and \(D^3=0\).

zh: 开篇定理改为这个全 nef 维数、非 big 的三维情形；结论仍仅为某个正整数 \(m\) 满足 \(H^0(X,mD)\ne0\)。
en: The opening theorem is restricted to this threefold case of full nef dimension with \(D^3=0\). Its conclusion remains only \(H^0(X,mD)\ne0\) for some positive integer \(m\).

zh: 把 \(\operatorname{ord}_x(s)\) 改用线性系及其成员重数的语言。
en: Express \(\operatorname{ord}_x(s)\) in terms of a linear system and the multiplicity of its members.

zh: 标量估计写为：对有效成员 \(E\in|kP_t|\)，有 \(\operatorname{mult}_x(E)\le4k(P_t^3)^{1/3}\)。行列式的消失也改用行列式线性系中有效成员的重数表述。
en: The scalar estimate is written as \(\operatorname{mult}_x(E)\le4k(P_t^3)^{1/3}\) for effective members \(E\in|kP_t|\). Determinant vanishing is likewise expressed as the multiplicity of an effective member of the determinant linear system.

zh: “这是相应命题，而不是 \(\kappa(D)=-\infty\) 的形式推论”是什么意思？
en: What does “this is the relevant proposition, rather than a formal consequence of \(\kappa(D)=-\infty\)” mean?

zh: \(\kappa(D)=-\infty\) 只说 \(D\) 的所有正整数倍都没有非零截面。它本身并不控制扰动后的 \(P_t\) 的线性系重数；这个重数上界需要另行建立的几何论证。
en: \(\kappa(D)=-\infty\) says that every positive integral multiple of \(D\) has no nonzero section. By itself it does not bound multiplicities in the linear systems of the perturbed divisors \(P_t\). That upper bound needs a separate geometric argument.

zh: 改写这句，使引用与证明依赖更直接。
en: Rewrite this sentence to state the reference and proof dependency directly.

zh: 改为直接引用提供该重数界的命题，不再使用容易引起歧义的否定句。
en: Replace it with a direct citation to the proposition providing the multiplicity bound.

zh: 在第一步之前说清楚 \(\kappa(D)=-\infty\) 是该步骤使用的假设。
en: Before the first step, explicitly state that \(\kappa(D)=-\infty\) is the assumption used there.

zh: 反证时暂时假设 \(\kappa(D)=-\infty\)，即对每个正整数 \(m\)，\(H^0(X,mD)=0\)。这是后续引理共同使用的反证假设，而不是开篇定理增加的条件。
en: For contradiction, temporarily assume \(\kappa(D)=-\infty\), equivalently \(H^0(X,mD)=0\) for every positive integer \(m\). This is the contradiction assumption shared by the subsequent lemmas, rather than an additional hypothesis of the opening theorem.

zh: 在第一步之前先写出这些辅助除子和参数的设定。
en: State the auxiliary divisors and parameters before the first step.

zh: 先固定 ample Cartier 除子 \(A\) 与小正有理数 \(\epsilon\)，令 \(t\to0^+\)，写明 \(a_t=((D+tA)^3)^{1/3}\)、\(r_t\) 的选择及 \(P_t=r_t(D+tA)\)，再陈述用到它们的引理。
