en: First fix an ample Cartier divisor \(A\) and a small positive rational \(\epsilon\). For \(t\to0^+\), specify \(a_t=((D+tA)^3)^{1/3}\), the choice of \(r_t\), and \(P_t=r_t(D+tA)\), before stating the lemmas that use them.

zh: 把各个 step 改成直接陈述结论的引理，后面几节分别围绕这些引理展开。
en: Replace the steps by lemmas stating their conclusions directly, and organize the later sections around their proofs.

zh: 证明路线封装为三个引理：标量重数界与可动曲线见证、七维大 jet 系统、行列式重数比较。后续章节分别展开这三个输入。
en: Package the route into three lemmas: the scalar multiplicity bound and movable witness, the sevenfold large jet system, and the determinant multiplicity comparison. Develop these three inputs in the later sections.

zh: 第一节标题用“Proof framework”，开头先设置辅助除子和参数，然后说明如何利用引理完成证明。
en: Title Section 1 “Proof framework”, beginning with the auxiliary divisors and parameters and then explaining how the lemmas complete the argument.

zh: 按照这个主线组织框架：大 jet 系统产生非零行列式；对角线秩界迫使高重数；可动见证给同一重数上界。明确几何输入建立之后，Frobenius 才把两种估计放在一起比较。
en: Organize the framework around this comparison: large jets produce a nonzero determinant; the diagonal rank bound forces high multiplicity; the movable witness gives an upper bound for that same multiplicity. Make clear that Frobenius compares these estimates once the geometric inputs are established.

zh: 在固定几何输入后，模 \(p\) 约化给出泛点秩 \(p^6\) 和小于 \(p^6/4\) 的对角线秩。因此行列式线性系的非零有效成员 \(E_p\) 满足
\[\frac34p^6<\operatorname{mult}_{(x\prime,x\prime)}(E_p)\le(80\epsilon+O(p^{-1}))p^6.\]
选 \(80\epsilon<3/4\)，再取大 \(p\)，两界矛盾。关键是大 jet 与受限全局重数的比较；几何输入的证明属于另外的引理。
en: With the geometric inputs fixed, reduction modulo \(p\) gives generic rank \(p^6\) and diagonal rank less than \(p^6/4\). A nonzero effective member \(E_p\) of the determinant linear system consequently satisfies
\[\frac34p^6<\operatorname{mult}_{(x\prime,x\prime)}(E_p)\le(80\epsilon+O(p^{-1}))p^6.\]

Choosing \(80\epsilon<3/4\) and then large \(p\) makes these bounds incompatible. The bridge compares large jets with restricted global multiplicity; establishing the geometric inputs is the task of separate lemmas.

zh: 这一框架用 LaTeX 的 setup 环境。
en: Use the LaTeX setup environment for this framework.

zh: 第一节保留“Proof framework”标题，用 Setup 环境依次写辅助选择、临时反证假设、三个引理的应用以及行列式重数矛盾；后续章节展开各引理的证明。
en: Section 1 retains the title “Proof framework”. Its Setup environment gives the auxiliary choices, the temporary contradiction assumption, the application of the three lemmas, and the determinant multiplicity contradiction. Later sections develop the lemma proofs.

zh: Setup 用 itemize：先写 \(A\)、\(P_t\)，不要在这里引入 \(\rho_t\)，然后写 \(\epsilon\) 和其他设定，最后说明 \(\epsilon\) 充分小的条件。
en: Itemize the setup: introduce \(A\) and \(P_t\) first, omit \(\rho_t\) here, then introduce \(\epsilon\) and the remaining data. State the smallness conditions on \(\epsilon\) last.

zh: Setup 已依次列出 \(A\)、\(P_t\)、\(\epsilon\)，不再引入 \(\rho_t\)，充分小的条件放在最后。
en: The setup now lists \(A\), \(P_t\), and \(\epsilon\) in that order, omits \(\rho_t\), and places the smallness conditions last.

zh: 定理放入第一节，节标题用“Theorem and proof”。
en: Place the theorem inside Section 1 and title the section “Theorem and proof”.

zh: 辅助除子改用 \(P_n\)，取 \(t=1/n\)；反证假设放到 Setup 之前。
en: Index the auxiliary divisors by \(P_n\), taking \(t=1/n\), and move the contradiction assumption before Setup.

zh: 全文统一为 \(P_n=r_n(D+A/n)\)，保持 \(P_n^3\to\epsilon^3\)。反证假设 \(\kappa(D)=-\infty\) 放在 Setup 之前。
en: The manuscript now uses \(P_n=r_n(D+A/n)\) throughout, preserving \(P_n^3\to\epsilon^3\). The contradiction assumption \(\kappa(D)=-\infty\) precedes Setup.

zh: 删掉定理后的说明段，直接进入证明。
en: Remove the explanatory paragraph after the theorem and begin the proof directly.

zh: 定理后直接进入证明，先作反证假设，再列 Setup；文末保留 Disclosure。
en: The theorem now leads directly into the proof, with the contradiction assumption followed by Setup. The disclosure remains at the end.

zh: 引理不要附括号说明。定理和引理尽量简短，但必须保留严格的数学条件与结论。Setup 后先说明全文将证明三个引理，陈述 Lemmas 1.1–1.3，再继续完成主证明。
en: Remove parenthetical lemma titles. Keep theorem and lemma statements concise but mathematically precise. After Setup, announce and state Lemmas 1.1–1.3, retaining the conclusions needed by the main proof, and then complete that proof.

zh: 第一节已改为 Setup → 三个引理的说明与陈述 → 完成证明。引理保留所需假设、量词和公式，计算与构造放入后续证明。
en: Section 1 now proceeds from Setup to the announcement and statements of the three lemmas, then completes the proof. The statements retain their hypotheses, quantifiers, and formulas; calculations and constructions are developed later.

zh: 接近一页的长证明应抽取可以独立使用的小引理；后续章节就按三个核心引理安排。
en: Extract reusable short lemmas from proofs approaching a full page. Organize the subsequent sections around the three core lemmas.

zh: 第一节之后恰有三节，分别证明 Lemmas 1.1–1.3。长证明已拆成有明确输入与结论的小引理，各节末作简短组装。文稿仍是尚未独立验证的证明草稿。
en: Exactly three sections follow Section 1, proving Lemmas 1.1–1.3 respectively. Long arguments have been divided into shorter lemmas with explicit inputs and conclusions, followed by brief assembly proofs. The manuscript remains an independently unverified proof draft.

zh: 去掉反证假设和辅助除子定义旁的公式编号。
en: Remove the equation numbers beside the contradiction assumption and the definition of the auxiliary divisors.

zh: 把 \(\epsilon\) 和 \(r_n\) 的选择以及 \(r_n\to\infty\)、\(P_n^3\to\epsilon^3\) 合并到前一项 \(P_n\) 的设定中。
en: Merge the choices of \(\epsilon\) and \(r_n\), together with \(r_n\to\infty\) and \(P_n^3\to\epsilon^3\), into the preceding setup item for \(P_n\).

zh: 能否不用 evaluation map 写这一条，而直接用线性系的语言？
en: Can this statement use the language of linear systems instead of an evaluation map?

zh: 如何取得光滑完全交旗标，使其末端曲线 \(C\) 满足 \(\mu_{\min}(\Omega_X^1|_C)\ge0\)？如果需要，请单独封装成引理。
en: How is a smooth complete-intersection flag obtained whose final curve \(C\) satisfies \(\mu_{\min}(\Omega_X^1|_C)\ge0\)? State this separately as a lemma if needed.

zh: 重新梳理主定理的逻辑。三个核心引理要独立封装，缩短陈述，使主证明清楚。
en: Reorganize the main theorem’s logic. Make the three core lemmas self-contained and shorten their statements so that the main proof is clear.

zh: 这里的 \(P_1\) 尚未定义；先前 \(R_n\) 中使用 \(P_{n,1}\) 的写法更清楚。
en: Here \(P_1\) has not been defined. The earlier notation \(P_{n,1}\) in \(R_n\) was clearer.

zh: 这里及后续所有相交数都显式添加 \(\cdot\)。
en: Insert an explicit \(\cdot\) here and throughout the subsequent intersection products.

zh: 前面的简述不必重复“Assume \(\kappa(D)=-\infty\)”，但要链接到后续小节中条件完整的引理；其余两个也一样。
en: The opening summaries need not repeat “Assume \(\kappa(D)=-\infty\)”, but should link to the fully stated lemmas in the later sections. Apply this to all three core lemmas.

zh: 把整数参数 \(Q\) 改为 \(N\)。
en: Rename the integer parameter \(Q\) to \(N\).

zh: 当前第一个核心引理能否不用 blowup，直接在原簇 \(X\) 上陈述？
en: Can the first core lemma be stated directly on \(X\), without a blowup?

zh: 不要另设 Lemmas 1.1–1.3。完整条件的三个引理放在各节开头，编号直接用 Lemmas 2.1、3.1、4.1；第一节列出它们并直接链接过去。
en: Do not create separate Lemmas 1.1–1.3. Place the three full statements at the beginnings of their respective sections, numbered Lemmas 2.1, 3.1, and 4.1. List and link those same lemmas in Section 1.

zh: 可以把曲线交数结论写在 \(X\) 上：对每个整数 \(N>0\) 和充分大的 \(n\)，极一般点 \(x\) 处有覆盖 \(X\) 的过点整曲线族，其一般成员满足 \((P_n+ND)\cdot C_t\le40\epsilon\operatorname{mult}_x C_t\)。把原可动见证的完全交曲线推下即可；例外除子的交数等于曲线在 \(x\) 的重数。后续模 \(p\) 约化还使用产生这个族的固定双有理模型，因此详细证明需要保留该构造，单独的交数不等式不足以保留全部约化数据。
en: The curve-bound conclusion can be stated on \(X\): for every integer \(N>0\) and all sufficiently large \(n\), a very general point \(x\) admits a covering family of integral curves through it, whose general member satisfies \((P_n+ND)\cdot C_t\le40\epsilon\operatorname{mult}_x C_t\). Push down general complete-intersection curves representing the existing movable witness; intersection with the exceptional divisor equals multiplicity at \(x\). Reduction modulo \(p\) also uses the fixed birational model producing this family, so that construction must remain in the detailed proof. The inequality alone does not retain all reduction data.

zh: 文稿现在在第二、三、四节开头分别陈述条件完整的 Lemmas 2.1、3.1、4.1。第一节列出并链接这三个引理，再完成定理证明；辅助引理随之自动重新编号。当前文稿仍保留 blowup 上的完整可动见证构造。
en: The full core statements now appear at the beginnings of Sections 2, 3, and 4 as Lemmas 2.1, 3.1, and 4.1. Section 1 lists and links these lemmas before completing the theorem proof; auxiliary statements are renumbered accordingly. The manuscript retains the complete movable-witness construction on the blowup.

zh: 如果可以，请把第一个核心引理陈述在原簇 \(X\) 上。引入曲线 \(C_t\) 的重数时，明确写出其定义。
en: If possible, state the first core lemma on the original \(X\). When introducing the multiplicity of \(C_t\), give its definition explicitly.

zh: 曲线在 \(x\) 的重数是否等于点 blowup 后严格变换与例外除子的交数？
en: Does the curve’s multiplicity at \(x\) equal the intersection of its strict transform with the exceptional divisor of the point blowup?

zh: 是。若 \(\pi:\widehat X=\operatorname{Bl}_xX\to X\)，\(J\) 是例外除子，\(\widehat C\) 是过 \(x\) 的整曲线 \(C\) 的严格变换，则 \(\operatorname{mult}_x(C)=J\cdot\widehat C\)。右边按各个分支的相交重数计数，并非只数交点个数。因此 \((P_n+ND)\cdot C=\pi^*(P_n+ND)\cdot\widehat C\)。
en: Yes. For \(\pi:\widehat X=\operatorname{Bl}_xX\to X\), exceptional divisor \(J\), and the strict transform \(\widehat C\) of an integral curve through \(x\), one has \(\operatorname{mult}_x(C)=J\cdot\widehat C\). This counts the intersection multiplicities of all branches, not just intersection points. Also \((P_n+ND)\cdot C=\pi^*(P_n+ND)\cdot\widehat C\) by the projection formula.

zh: 把这个重数与 blowup 相交数的恒等式记录到第二节，作为一个小引理。
en: Record this identity between multiplicity and blowup intersection in Section 2 as a short lemma.

zh: 在引理之前加入 jet separation 的严格数学定义。
en: Give the strict mathematical definition of jet separation before the lemmas.

zh: Lemma 2.1 已改用 \(X\) 上的覆盖曲线族，并保留生成这个族的固定光滑双有理模型及两个非常丰沛线性系；点理想在该模型上可逆，确保主证明能恢复所需的 blowup 见证。Setup 定义 \(\operatorname{mult}_x(C)\) 为曲线局部环的 Hilbert–Samuel 重数。第二节增加 Lemma 2.2，证明 \(\operatorname{mult}_x(C)=J\cdot\widehat C\)，并在主证明和曲线族构造中引用。
en: Lemma 2.1 now uses a covering curve family on \(X\), retaining the fixed smooth birational model and two very ample systems generating it. The point ideal is invertible on that model, so the main proof can recover the required blowup witness. Setup defines \(\operatorname{mult}_x(C)\) as the Hilbert–Samuel multiplicity of the curve’s local ring. The new Lemma 2.2 proves \(\operatorname{mult}_x(C)=J\cdot\widehat C\) and is cited in the main proof and the curve-family construction.

zh: 对光滑射影簇 \(W\) 上的 Cartier 除子 \(L\)、点 \(z\) 和整数 \(s\ge0\)，\(|L|\) 在 \(z\) 分离 \(s\)-jets，是指 \(\mathcal O_{W,z}(L)/\mathfrak m_z^{s+1}\mathcal O_{W,z}(L)\) 中每个类都可由某个全局截面的局部芽表示，其中 \(\mathfrak m_z\) 是局部环的极大理想。选定局部平凡化后，这等价于每个总次数不超过 \(s\) 的 Taylor 多项式都由一个全局截面实现。此定义已加入 Setup，在三个核心引理之前，不另写 evaluation map。
en: For a Cartier divisor \(L\) on a smooth projective variety \(W\), a point \(z\), and an integer \(s\ge0\), \(|L|\) separates \(s\)-jets at \(z\) if every class in \(\mathcal O_{W,z}(L)/\mathfrak m_z^{s+1}\mathcal O_{W,z}(L)\) is represented by the germ of a global section. Here \(\mathfrak m_z\) is the maximal ideal of the local ring. After a local trivialization, this means every Taylor polynomial of total degree at most \(s\) is realized by a global section. The definition is now in Setup before the three core lemmas, without displaying an evaluation map.

zh: 把文稿改成 Meng–Zhang 的样式。
en: Use Meng–Zhang style for the manuscript.

zh: 根据已有的 Meng–Zhang TeX 参考样式，采用 12-point AMS 排版、1.3 倍行距、相应页边与页眉尺寸；缩短主证明及衔接说明。公式、引理与定理陈述、编号、引用标签均保留。
en: The manuscript now uses the existing Meng–Zhang TeX reference layout: 12-point AMS typography, 1.3 line spacing, and the corresponding page and running-header dimensions. The main proof and transitions are more concise. Formulas, theorem and lemma statements, numbering, and reference labels are preserved.

zh: 引理 2.1 还是在 blowup 上表述更好。去掉新引入的曲线重数、Hilbert–Samuel 定义及转换小引理，直接用模型上的 $H_1,H_2$ 写相交不等式，不另引入曲线类 $\gamma$。
en: State Lemma 2.1 on the blowup. Remove the newly introduced curve multiplicity, its Hilbert–Samuel definition, and the conversion lemma. Write the intersection inequalities directly using $H_1,H_2$ on a model, without a separate curve-class symbol $\gamma$.

zh: 引理 2.1 改为：在很一般点的 blowup $\pi:\widehat X\to X$ 上，存在光滑射影双有理模型 $f:V\to\widehat X$ 和 ample Cartier 除子 $H_1,H_2$，使得 $f^*J\cdot H_1\cdot H_2>0$ 且 $f^*\pi^*(P_n+ND)\cdot H_1\cdot H_2<40\epsilon\,f^*J\cdot H_1\cdot H_2$。主证明和引理 4.1 使用同一组数据。删去曲线重数定义及转换引理；保留后续论证所需的除子重数。
en: Lemma 2.1 now gives, over the blowup $\pi:\widehat X\to X$ at a very general point, a smooth projective birational model $f:V\to\widehat X$ and ample Cartier divisors $H_1,H_2$ with $f^*J\cdot H_1\cdot H_2>0$ and $f^*\pi^*(P_n+ND)\cdot H_1\cdot H_2<40\epsilon\,f^*J\cdot H_1\cdot H_2$. The theorem proof and Lemma 4.1 use the same data. The curve-multiplicity definition and conversion lemma are removed; divisor multiplicities needed later are retained.

zh: 把 separated jets 的定义用严格数学公式写清楚，不要只用 “represented modulo” 等描述性语言。
en: Write the definition of separated jets as a precise mathematical formula, rather than describing it only as being represented modulo a power of the maximal ideal.

zh: 统一设定中，$|L|$ 在 $z$ 处分离 $s$ 阶 jets 的定义改为：$\forall f\in\mathcal O_{W,z}(L),\ \exists\sigma\in H^0(W,\mathcal O_W(L))$ 使得 $\sigma_z-f\in\mathfrak m_z^{s+1}\mathcal O_{W,z}(L)$。这里 $\sigma_z$ 是截面的芽。
en: In the Setup, $|L|$ separates $s$-jets at $z$ precisely when $\forall f\in\mathcal O_{W,z}(L),\ \exists\sigma\in H^0(W,\mathcal O_W(L))$ such that $\sigma_z-f\in\mathfrak m_z^{s+1}\mathcal O_{W,z}(L)$. Here $\sigma_z$ is the germ of the global section.

zh: $f^*J\cdot H_1\cdot H_2>0$ 不是必然成立吗？$f^*J$ 有效，两个除子都 ample。
en: Is $f^*J\cdot H_1\cdot H_2>0$ not automatic, since $f^*J$ is effective and both divisors are ample?

zh: 是的，关键是 $f^*J$ 非零且有效。写成 $f^*J=\sum_i a_iE_i$，其中 $a_i>0$，每个 $E_i$ 是不可约曲面。两个 ample 除子在 $E_i$ 上的限制仍 ample，因此 $(H_1|_{E_i})\cdot(H_2|_{E_i})>0$，求和即得 $f^*J\cdot H_1\cdot H_2>0$。已从各陈述中删去这项冗余条件，只在定义分母时说明一次。
en: Yes; the key is that $f^*J$ is nonzero and effective. Write $f^*J=\sum_i a_iE_i$ with $a_i>0$ and each $E_i$ an integral surface. The restrictions of $H_1,H_2$ to each $E_i$ remain ample, hence $(H_1|_{E_i})\cdot(H_2|_{E_i})>0$. Summing gives $f^*J\cdot H_1\cdot H_2>0$. This redundant condition is removed from the statements and justified once where it is used as a denominator.

zh: 把 blowup 的记号改为 $\widetilde X$。
en: Use $\widetilde X$ for the blowup.

zh: 全文的 blowup 记号统一改为 $\widetilde X$。
en: The blowup notation is now $\widetilde X$ throughout the manuscript.

zh: 把点 blowup 的例外除子记为 $E$。
en: Use $E$ for the exceptional divisor of the point blowup.

zh: 点 blowup $\pi:\widetilde X\to X$ 的例外除子统一记为 $E$，相关相交不等式和分母同步修改。乘积重数小引理的局部除子改记为 $F$，以免混淆。
en: The exceptional divisor of the point blowup $\pi:\widetilde X\to X$ is now denoted by $E$ throughout, including the intersection inequalities and denominator. The local divisor in the product-multiplicity lemma is denoted by $F$ to avoid ambiguity.

zh: 这里的 $\mathbb T$ 是什么？
en: What does $\mathbb T$ denote here?

zh: $\mathbb T$ 是 $Z$ 中去掉两个直和分量所给截面后的开集：$\mathbb T=Z\setminus(S_1\cup S_2)$。在局部纤维坐标 $[u:v]$ 中，就是 $u\ne0$ 且 $v\ne0$；每条纤维是 $\mathbb P^1\setminus\{0,\infty\}\cong\mathbb G_m$。
en: $\mathbb T$ is the open subset obtained by removing the two summand sections from $Z$: $\mathbb T=Z\setminus(S_1\cup S_2)$. In local fibre coordinates $[u:v]$, this means $u\ne0$ and $v\ne0$; each fibre is $\mathbb P^1\setminus\{0,\infty\}\cong\mathbb G_m$.

zh: 把这段分成两个 item：先介绍 $Z,\mathbb T$，再介绍除子。
en: Split the Setup passage into two items: first $Z,\mathbb T$, then the divisor notation.

zh: 第一项定义两个投影、射影丛 $Z$、直和截面 $S_1,S_2$ 及开集 $\mathbb T$；第二项定义除子的拉回记号、$\xi$、$R(P,N)$ 和 $R_n$。
en: The first item defines the two projections, the projective bundle $Z$, its summand sections $S_1,S_2$, and the open subset $\mathbb T$. The second defines the divisor pullbacks, $\xi$, $R(P,N)$, and $R_n$.

zh: 前面的 “Put $P=P_n$” 多余；使用引理 4.1 时再说取 $P=P_n$ 即可。
en: The early sentence “Put $P=P_n$” is unnecessary. Specify $P=P_n$ when applying Lemma 4.1.

zh: 主证明中的相交计算直接用 $P_n$，只在应用引理 4.1 的一句中指定 $P=P_n$。
en: The theorem proof now uses $P_n$ directly in its intersection calculations, and specifies $P=P_n$ only when applying Lemma 4.1.

zh: 写一个临时文稿，题为 Nef Abundance: Framework，只写第一节，看看如何不在第一节使用 blowup 的表述。允许定义 $f_*(H_1\cdot H_2)$ 这样的类。
en: Create a temporary Nef Abundance: Framework draft containing only Section 1, to see how its statements can be written without naming a blowup. A class such as $f_*(H_1\cdot H_2)$ may be defined.

zh: 数值类 $\gamma=f_*(H_1\cdot H_2)$ 本身不决定点 $x$ 处的分母。保留模型 $f:V\to X$ 和 ample Cartier 除子 $H_1,H_2$，使 $\mathcal I_x\mathcal O_V=\mathcal O_V(-B_x)$，并定义 $\ell_x(\gamma)=B_x\cdot H_1\cdot H_2$。这里 $\ell_x(\gamma)$ 依赖所选 witness，不是数值类的内在函数。
对 $X$ 上任意有效 Cartier 除子 $F$，有 $\operatorname{mult}_x(F)\,\ell_x(\gamma)\le F\cdot\gamma$：局部方程属于点理想的相应幂，故 $f^*F\ge\operatorname{mult}_x(F)B_x$，再用投影公式。降特征前必须固定所选 witness 及点理想的恒等式。
en: The numerical class $\gamma=f_*(H_1\cdot H_2)$ alone does not determine the denominator at $x$. Retain the model $f:V\to X$ and ample Cartier divisors $H_1,H_2$ with $\mathcal I_x\mathcal O_V=\mathcal O_V(-B_x)$, and define $\ell_x(\gamma)=B_x\cdot H_1\cdot H_2$. This notation depends on the chosen witness; it is not an intrinsic function of the numerical class.

For every effective Cartier divisor $F$ on $X$, $\operatorname{mult}_x(F)\,\ell_x(\gamma)\le F\cdot\gamma$: a local equation lies in the corresponding power of the point ideal, so $f^*F\ge\operatorname{mult}_x(F)B_x$, and the projection formula gives the inequality. The chosen witness and point-ideal identity must be fixed before reducing characteristic.

zh: 独立的三页临时文稿只包含第一节，保留统一设定、三个核心引理的陈述和利用它们完成证明的主线。主要不等式写为 $(P_n+ND)\cdot\gamma<40\epsilon\,\ell_x(\gamma)$。三个引理仍是未在本草稿中重证的输入，原三维文稿保留。
en: The separate three-page temporary draft contains only Section 1: the Setup, the statements of three core lemmas, and their assembly into the proof. The main inequality is $(P_n+ND)\cdot\gamma<40\epsilon\,\ell_x(\gamma)$. The three lemmas remain inputs whose proofs are not included in this draft. The existing threefold note is retained.

zh: x-marked class 是标准术语吗？
en: Is x-marked class standard terminology?

zh: 这是 Framework 临时引入的名称，不是标准术语。它记录模型 f、V、两个 ample 除子及点理想的拉回；数值曲线类只是这些数据的一部分。
en: It is terminology introduced locally in this framework, not standard terminology. It records the birational model, the two ample divisors and the pullback of the point ideal, beyond the numerical curve class.

zh: $\ell_x(\gamma)$ 在 X 上反映什么信息？
en: What does $\ell_x(\gamma)$ measure on X?

zh: 在当时的记号中，它是从选定模型的一般完全交曲线推前，再按取倍系数归一化后，所选曲线 cycle 在 x 处的重数。必须保留所选代表或曲线族；它不是任意代表的重数，也不是数值类本身的不变量。
en: In the notation used at that stage, it is the multiplicity at x of the chosen curve cycle, obtained by pushing forward a general complete intersection from the selected model and normalizing by the multiples used. The chosen representative or family must be retained; it is not the multiplicity of any representative or an invariant of the numerical class.

zh: $\gamma$ 本身与点 x 无关吗？
en: Is $\gamma$ independent of x?

zh: 数值类本身没有记录标记点，但模型和交积的选择可以依赖 x，构造得到的 $\gamma$ 也可以随 x 变化。
en: The numerical class carries no marked-point datum, but the model and intersection product may be chosen depending on x, so the resulting $\gamma$ may vary with x.

zh: 高模型上两个 ample 除子的交积推前叫什么？强可动曲线一定能这样写吗？
en: What is the pushforward of the intersection of two ample divisors on a higher model called? Must a strongly movable curve have this form?

zh: 这是 strongly movable curve class 的构造。BDPP Definition 1.3 用双有理模型上一般 very ample 完全交曲线的推前定义单个强可动曲线；ample 除子取足够大倍数，再除以取倍系数，可得到同一数值射线。
强可动锥的元素可以是这些类的和或极限，不能把单一完全交推前的表示要求自动施于所有锥元素。参考：BDPP Definition 1.3，https://sebastien.boucksom.perso.math.cnrs.fr/publis/BDPP.pdf
en: This is the strongly movable construction. BDPP Definition 1.3 defines an individual strongly movable curve by pushing forward a general very ample complete intersection on a birational model. Taking sufficiently large multiples of ample divisors and normalizing gives the same numerical ray.

Elements of the strongly movable cone may be sums or limits of such classes; a single complete-intersection representation cannot automatically be required of every cone element. Reference: BDPP Definition 1.3, https://sebastien.boucksom.perso.math.cnrs.fr/publis/BDPP.pdf

zh: $\ell$ 和 $\gamma$ 是否没有关系？我后来理解它们都与 H₁、H₂ 有关。
en: Are $\ell$ and $\gamma$ unrelated? I now see that both depend on H₁ and H₂.

zh: 它们共享同一交积数据：$\gamma=f_*(H_1\cdot H_2)$，而 $\ell=B_x\cdot H_1\cdot H_2$。前者保留推前数值类，却遗忘了点处的贡献。
en: They share the same intersection data: $\gamma=f_*(H_1\cdot H_2)$, while $\ell=B_x\cdot H_1\cdot H_2$. The former retains the pushed-forward numerical class but forgets the local contribution.

zh: 如果只在 X 上写，这段是在说什么？
en: What is this saying if it is written only on X?

zh: 使用选定曲线族的一般有理 cycle $\Gamma$，满足 $[\Gamma]=\gamma$、$\operatorname{mult}_x\Gamma=\ell$。对每个有效 Cartier 除子 F，选择不包含在 F 内的一般成员，由局部交数与全局交数比较得到 $\operatorname{mult}_xF\,\ell\le F\cdot\gamma$。这是 Setup 的一般重数不等式。
en: Use the normalized general curve cycle $\Gamma$ from the chosen family, with $[\Gamma]=\gamma$ and $\operatorname{mult}_x\Gamma=\ell$. For each effective Cartier divisor F, choose a general member not contained in F. Comparing local with global intersection gives $\operatorname{mult}_xF\,\ell\le F\cdot\gamma$. This is the general multiplicity inequality in Setup.

zh: 刚才说的是哪条不等式？是三维引理 2.1，或 Framework 的 1.1 吗？
en: Which inequality is this: Threefold Lemma 2.1 or Framework Lemma 1.1?

zh: 刚才“原文”的措辞不准确。Setup 的不等式是 $\operatorname{mult}_xF\,\ell\le F\cdot\gamma$。
Framework 1.1 对应三维 2.1，它要求存在所选模型数据，使 $(P_n+ND)\cdot\gamma<40\epsilon\,\ell$。这是次数与点重数比值很小的存在性输入，两条不等式的用途不同。
en: The earlier wording “the original text” was imprecise. The Setup inequality is $\operatorname{mult}_xF\,\ell\le F\cdot\gamma$.

Framework 1.1 corresponds to Threefold 2.1 and supplies chosen model data with $(P_n+ND)\cdot\gamma<40\epsilon\,\ell$. It is an existence input with a small degree-to-point-multiplicity ratio. The two inequalities serve different purposes.

zh: $\ell$ 能用别的方式理解吗，像 $\gamma$ 在 x 处的重数？
en: Can $\ell$ be interpreted differently, as the multiplicity of $\gamma$ at x?

zh: 可以理解为所选一般曲线 cycle 归一化后的重数；但不是数值类 $\gamma$ 本身的重数。不同模型或不同交积表示可能给出不同的局部重数。
en: It can be interpreted as the normalized multiplicity of the chosen general curve cycle, but not as a multiplicity of the numerical class $\gamma$ itself. Different models or product representations may give different local multiplicities.

zh: $\gamma$ 放大两倍，$\ell$ 按定义也应放大两倍吧？
en: Should doubling $\gamma$ also double $\ell$?

zh: 正确。例如 $H_1\mapsto2H_1$ 时，$\gamma\mapsto2\gamma$，$\ell\mapsto2\ell$，两者的比值不变。先前把问题归因于缩放是不准确的；真正的问题是不同表示，而不是一致缩放。
en: Yes. For example, replacing $H_1$ by $2H_1$ doubles both $\gamma$ and $\ell$, preserving their ratio. The earlier attribution to rescaling was inaccurate; the issue is nonunique representations, not consistent rescaling.

zh: 同一 $\gamma$ 写成 $f_*(H_1H_2)=f_*(H_3H_4)$，$\ell$ 可以不同吗？
en: Can two products with $f_*(H_1H_2)=f_*(H_3H_4)$ give different $\ell$?

zh: 能，即使模型相同且四个除子都 ample。取 $V=\operatorname{Bl}_x\mathbb P^3$，$L=f^*\mathcal O(1)$，E 为例外除子；令 $H_1=H_2=3L-E$，$H_3=H_4=3L-2E$。点投影的图把 V 嵌入 $\mathbb P^3\times\mathbb P^2$，这两种除子分别对应 $\mathcal O(2,1)$ 与 $\mathcal O(1,2)$，故均 ample。
由 $L|_E=0$、$E|_E=\mathcal O_{\mathbb P^2}(-1)$ 得 $E^3=1$。两种交积的推前都等于 $9[\mathrm{line}]$，但 $E\cdot(3L-E)^2=1$、$E\cdot(3L-2E)^2=4$。这直接说明数值类不决定点处贡献；此例不依赖研究中的 $K_X\sim0$ 假设。
en: Yes, even on the same model with all four divisors ample. Let $V=\operatorname{Bl}_x\mathbb P^3$, $L=f^*\mathcal O(1)$, and E be exceptional. Set $H_1=H_2=3L-E$ and $H_3=H_4=3L-2E$. The graph of projection from x embeds V in $\mathbb P^3\times\mathbb P^2$; these divisors correspond to $\mathcal O(2,1)$ and $\mathcal O(1,2)$ and are ample.

Since $L|_E=0$ and $E|_E=\mathcal O_{\mathbb P^2}(-1)$, $E^3=1$. Both products push forward to $9[\mathrm{line}]$, but $E\cdot(3L-E)^2=1$ and $E\cdot(3L-2E)^2=4$. Thus the numerical class does not determine the local contribution. This example does not use the research hypothesis $K_X\sim0$.

zh: $\gamma$、$\ell$ 的记号容易让人误以为不依赖模型。第一节直接在 V 上做，把 1.1–1.3 改一下。
en: The notation $\gamma$, $\ell$ can suggest model independence. Rewrite Section 1 and 1.1–1.3 directly on V.

zh: 现在明确写出 $f:V\to X$、$\mathcal I_x\mathcal O_V=\mathcal O_V(-B_x)$ 和 V 上的 ample Cartier 除子 $H_1,H_2$，不用 marked-class、$\gamma$ 或 $\ell$ 缩写。1.1 不仅要求存在高模型，还要求其上两个 ample 除子满足 $f^*(P_n+ND)\cdot H_1\cdot H_2<40\epsilon B_x\cdot H_1\cdot H_2$。
1.2 的数学内容不变；1.3 的对应界为 $f^*(P+ND)\cdot H_1\cdot H_2<\frac38 B_x\cdot H_1\cdot H_2$。Setup 和主证明同步衔接，其余条件保留。三个几何输入仍未在这个临时框架中独立验证。
en: The draft now explicitly records $f:V\to X$, $\mathcal I_x\mathcal O_V=\mathcal O_V(-B_x)$, and ample Cartier divisors $H_1,H_2$ on V, without marked-class, $\gamma$ or $\ell$ abbreviations. Lemma 1.1 requires not only a higher model, but two ample divisors on it satisfying $f^*(P_n+ND)\cdot H_1\cdot H_2<40\epsilon B_x\cdot H_1\cdot H_2$.

Lemma 1.2 is mathematically unchanged. The corresponding bound in 1.3 is $f^*(P+ND)\cdot H_1\cdot H_2<\frac38 B_x\cdot H_1\cdot H_2$. Setup and the main assembly are updated consistently, with the remaining conditions retained. The three geometric inputs are still not independently verified in this temporary framework.

zh: 引理 1.1 中的 $\mathcal I_x$ 用在哪里？最后的交数界没有看到它。
en: Where is $\mathcal I_x$ used in Lemma 1.1? It does not appear in the final intersection bound.

zh: 点理想通过 $\mathcal I_x\mathcal O_V=\mathcal O_V(-E_x)$ 确定 $E_x$。若有效 Cartier 除子 F 在 x 的重数为 m，局部方程属于 $\mathfrak m_x^m$，故 $f^*F\ge mE_x$。
与 $H_1,H_2$ 相交得到 $\operatorname{mult}_x(F)E_x\cdot H_1\cdot H_2\le f^*F\cdot H_1\cdot H_2$。点理想虽未写在最终交数界中，却使 $E_x$ 与 x 处的重数绑定。
en: The point ideal determines $E_x$ through $\mathcal I_x\mathcal O_V=\mathcal O_V(-E_x)$. If an effective Cartier divisor F has multiplicity m at x, its local equation belongs to $\mathfrak m_x^m$, so $f^*F\ge mE_x$.

Intersecting with $H_1,H_2$ gives $\operatorname{mult}_x(F)E_x\cdot H_1\cdot H_2\le f^*F\cdot H_1\cdot H_2$. Although the point ideal is absent from the final numerical bound, it binds $E_x$ to multiplicity at x.

zh: $\mathcal I_x$ 是极大理想吗？为什么不用专业的 $\mathfrak m_x$ 记号？
en: Is $\mathcal I_x$ a maximal ideal? Why not use the standard notation $\mathfrak m_x$?

zh: 应区分局部环的极大理想 $\mathfrak m_x\subset\mathcal O_{X,x}$ 与整个 X 上的点理想层 $\mathcal I_x$；两者由 $(\mathcal I_x)_x=\mathfrak m_x$ 联系。模型上的等式用理想层，局部方程的重数论证可用极大理想。先前口头将两者混称为极大理想不够精确。
en: Distinguish the maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_x\subset\mathcal O_{X,x}$ from the ideal sheaf $\mathcal I_x$ of the point on X. They are related by $(\mathcal I_x)_x=\mathfrak m_x$. The model identity uses an ideal sheaf, whereas the local multiplicity argument may use the maximal ideal. The earlier oral use of “maximal ideal” for both was imprecise.

zh: 把 $B_x$ 换成 $E_x$ 是不是更好？
en: Would $E_x$ be better notation than $B_x$?

zh: 已全文统一为 $E_x$，以提示它是例外除子，同时保留扩张理想的定义。在高模型上它可能带重数，不必是约化除子。
en: The notation is now $E_x$ throughout, suggesting an exceptional divisor while retaining its definition by the extended ideal. On a higher model it may have multiplicities and need not be reduced.

zh: 这种不一定来自一次 blow-up 的例外除子，有专业术语吗？
en: Is there standard terminology for this exceptional divisor when it need not come from a single blowup?

zh: 可以准确解释为点的 blow-up 的例外除子的全变换。设 $b:\operatorname{Bl}_xX\to X$，E 为其例外除子。由于扩张理想可逆，blow-up 的泛性质给出 $f=b\circ g$，而 $E_x=g^*E$。
这是解释用的分解，不插入当前 Framework 正文。参考 Stacks 的 blow-up 泛性质与例外除子： https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0806 和 https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/02OS。
en: It can be described precisely as the total transform of the exceptional divisor of the blowup of x. Let $b:\operatorname{Bl}_xX\to X$ with exceptional divisor E. Invertibility of the extended ideal gives $f=b\circ g$ by the universal property of the blowup, and $E_x=g^*E$.

This factorization is explanatory and is not inserted into the current Framework text. See the Stacks universal property and exceptional divisor results: https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0806 and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/02OS.

zh: 能否只用 $f_*\mathcal O_V(-E)=\mathcal I_x$ 定义 E？这样是否唯一？
en: Can E be defined only by $f_*\mathcal O_V(-E)=\mathcal I_x$? Is it then unique?

zh: 仅要求推前等式比要求 $\mathcal I_x\mathcal O_V=\mathcal O_V(-E)$ 弱，通常不能唯一确定 E。推前条件也能给出 $\mathcal I_x\mathcal O_V\subseteq\mathcal O_V(-E)$，所以不能说它完全无法得到重数下界；这里的关键是唯一性与保持原有条件。
en: The pushforward identity alone is weaker than $\mathcal I_x\mathcal O_V=\mathcal O_V(-E)$ and generally does not uniquely determine E. It still gives $\mathcal I_x\mathcal O_V\subseteq\mathcal O_V(-E)$, so it should not be said to give no multiplicity lower bound at all. The issue here is uniqueness and retaining the original condition.

zh: 真的能有两个有效例外除子，它们负号对应的层推前相同吗？
en: Can two effective exceptional divisors really have the same pushforward of their negative divisor sheaves?

zh: 能。在光滑三维 X 上，先取 $b:Y=\operatorname{Bl}_xX\to X$，E 为例外除子；再取 $g:V=\operatorname{Bl}_pY\to Y$，其中 $p\in E$。记 E′ 为 E 的严格变换，F 为第二个例外除子，$f=b\circ g$。则 $g^*E=E^{\prime}+F$，且 $f_*\mathcal O_V(-E^{\prime})=f_*\mathcal O_V(-E^{\prime}-F)=\mathcal I_x$。
函数在 x 消失等价于沿 E′ 至少消失一次，此时沿 F 也自动消失一次，所以额外 F 条件是冗余的。推前不能区分这两个除子，但扩张理想精确给出 $\mathcal I_x\mathcal O_V=\mathcal O_V(-E^{\prime}-F)$。这是直接几何计算的例子，不是在验证 Framework 的三个输入。
en: Yes. For a smooth threefold X, first take $b:Y=\operatorname{Bl}_xX\to X$ with exceptional divisor E, then $g:V=\operatorname{Bl}_pY\to Y$ with $p\in E$. Let E′ be the strict transform and F the second exceptional divisor, with $f=b\circ g$. Then $g^*E=E^{\prime}+F$ and $f_*\mathcal O_V(-E^{\prime})=f_*\mathcal O_V(-E^{\prime}-F)=\mathcal I_x$.

A function vanishes at x exactly when it vanishes along E′ at least once; it then automatically vanishes along F at least once. The extra F condition is redundant. Pushforward cannot distinguish the two divisors, but the extended ideal gives precisely $\mathcal I_x\mathcal O_V=\mathcal O_V(-E^{\prime}-F)$. This is a direct geometric calculation, not verification of the three Framework inputs.

zh: 这不是抽象拉回，而是理想拉回的像吧？
en: Is this the image of the pulled-back ideal rather than the abstract pullback?

zh: 正确。$\mathcal I_x\mathcal O_V=\operatorname{Im}(f^*\mathcal I_x\to\mathcal O_V)$，称为扩张理想。自然映射未必单射，不能直接写 $f^*\mathcal I_x\cong\mathcal O_V(-E_x)$。先前口头简称“拉回”不够精确，现明确写为映射的像。
en: Correct: $\mathcal I_x\mathcal O_V=\operatorname{Im}(f^*\mathcal I_x\to\mathcal O_V)$ is the extended ideal. The natural map need not be injective, so one cannot simply write $f^*\mathcal I_x\cong\mathcal O_V(-E_x)$. The earlier oral abbreviation “pullback” was imprecise; it is now explicitly the image of the map.

zh: 明确定义点理想与扩张理想；直接选使扩张理想可逆的模型，不写 blow-up 分解。全部顺一下。
en: Define the point ideal and extended ideal explicitly, and choose a model on which the extended ideal is invertible. Omit the blowup factorization and align the whole text.

zh: Setup、1.1、1.3、主证明及草稿说明已对齐：选光滑射影双有理模型使扩张理想可逆，写作 $\mathcal I_x\mathcal O_V=\mathcal O_V(-E_x)$，在固定模型上唯一确定有效 Cartier 除子 $E_x$；所有交数仍在 V 上计算。正文未增加分解，1.2、常数、量词与未经独立验证的状态保持。
en: Setup, 1.1, 1.3, the main assembly and draft disclosure are aligned: choose a smooth projective birational model with invertible extended ideal, written as $\mathcal I_x\mathcal O_V=\mathcal O_V(-E_x)$, which uniquely determines the effective Cartier divisor $E_x$ on the fixed model. All intersections remain on V. No factorization is added to the manuscript; 1.2, the constants, quantifiers and independently unverified status are retained.

zh: 不用写 $(\mathcal I_x)_x=\mathfrak m_x$；$\mathfrak m_x$ 后面有用到吗？
en: Omit $(\mathcal I_x)_x=\mathfrak m_x$. Is $\mathfrak m_x$ used later?

zh: 原稿只在局部重数论证用过一次；现在将它改为 F 的局部方程是 $\mathcal I_x^{\operatorname{mult}_x(F)}$ 的局部截面，删去额外的 $\mathfrak m_x$ 记号。仍保留点理想层和扩张理想的定义。
en: The earlier draft used it only once in the local multiplicity argument. This now says that a local equation of F is a local section of $\mathcal I_x^{\operatorname{mult}_x(F)}$, removing the extra $\mathfrak m_x$ notation while retaining the definitions of the point ideal sheaf and extended ideal.

zh: 把 E_x 改为 E_V，直接写有效例外 Cartier 除子，删去后面的唯一性句。
en: Rename E_x as E_V, state directly that it is effective exceptional Cartier, and remove the subsequent uniqueness sentence.

zh: 现用 $E_V$，直接要求有效的 $\pi$-exceptional Cartier 除子满足扩张理想恒等式，不再重复唯一性句。
en: The notation is $E_V$, directly requiring an effective $\pi$-exceptional Cartier divisor satisfying the extended-ideal identity, without repeating the uniqueness sentence.

zh: V 是否依赖 x？每换一个点就必须换模型吗？
en: Does V depend on x? Must the model change whenever the point changes?

zh: 模型可以依赖 x，不要求统一；但不必每换点就换。例如同时 blow up 两个不同点的模型，可分别用于这两个点。
en: The model may depend on x; no uniform model is required. It need not change at every new point: a model blowing up two distinct points can be used for either point.

zh: 为什么保留 $P_n+ND$，不整体另命名除子？
en: Why retain $P_n+ND$ instead of renaming the whole sum?

zh: 单看 1.1 可以合并记号，但后两个引理分别需要 $P_n$ 的体积归一化与固定的 N 参数，故保留分解。按最后要求，不增加额外说明到正文。
en: The sum could be renamed in 1.1 alone, but the next two inputs separately need the volume normalization of $P_n$ and the fixed parameter N. The decomposition is retained, without adding extra explanation to the manuscript.

zh: 把充分大的下界及依赖写清楚；X、D、A 固定，写 $n_0=n_0(\epsilon,N)$。
en: Make the sufficiently large threshold explicit; X, D and A are fixed, so write $n_0=n_0(\epsilon,N)$.

zh: 1.1 明确 $n_0=n_0(\epsilon,N)$，不依赖随后选择的点或模型；模型数据与泛函可依赖 x、n、N。
en: Lemma 1.1 uses $n_0=n_0(\epsilon,N)$ independently of subsequent point or model choices; the data and functional may depend on x, n and N.

zh: 1.1 能否把 very general 改成 general？
en: Can very general in 1.1 be strengthened to general?

zh: 当前证明使用可数排除，未补出非空开集上的统一论证，暂保留 very general。这不是宣称绝对无法加强，而是现有论证尚未支持加强。
en: The current argument uses countably many exclusions and has not supplied a uniform argument on a nonempty open set. We retain very general; this does not assert that strengthening is impossible, only that it is not yet justified.

zh: 写可数多个真闭子集 $Z_j$ 的并；依赖放在首次定义，不在末尾重复。
en: Use countably many proper closed subsets $Z_j$, with dependencies at the first definition rather than repeated at the end.

zh: 先写 $n_0=n_0(\epsilon,N)$ 与 $Z_j=Z_j(\epsilon,N)\subsetneq X$。同一例外集统一适用于全部 $n\ge n_0$；在补集的每个点再选择模型与泛函。
en: First introduce $n_0=n_0(\epsilon,N)$ and $Z_j=Z_j(\epsilon,N)\subsetneq X$. The same exceptional set applies to all $n\ge n_0$; model data and a functional are then chosen at each point of its complement.

zh: 高模型映射 f 全部换成 $\pi$。
en: Replace f by $\pi$ for the higher-model morphism.

zh: Framework 的高模型映射统一为 $\pi$，乘积投影 $p_i$ 不变。
en: The higher-model morphism is now consistently $\pi$; the product projections $p_i$ are unchanged.

zh: 固定模型与 H₁、H₂ 后，是泛函还是范数？1.1 是说相应大小很小吗？
en: Do a fixed model and H₁, H₂ define a functional or a norm? Does 1.1 say that its value is small?

zh: $\Phi(L)=\dfrac{\pi^*L\cdot H_1\cdot H_2}{E_V\cdot H_1\cdot H_2}$ 是 $N^1(X)_{\mathbb R}$ 上的线性泛函，分母为正。对有效 Cartier F，$\operatorname{mult}_x(F)\le\Phi(F)$。当时的 1.1 选择数据使 $\Phi(P_n+ND)<40\epsilon$；数值参数在后续修订中重新命名。
它不是范数：$\Phi(-L)=-\Phi(L)$，可以为负，不满足范数的非负性与正负对称性。
en: $\Phi(L)=\dfrac{\pi^*L\cdot H_1\cdot H_2}{E_V\cdot H_1\cdot H_2}$ is a linear functional on $N^1(X)_{\mathbb R}$ with positive denominator. For effective Cartier F, $\operatorname{mult}_x(F)\le\Phi(F)$. At this stage 1.1 chooses data with $\Phi(P_n+ND)<40\epsilon$; the parameter is renamed in a later revision.
It is not a norm: $\Phi(-L)=-\Phi(L)$, and values may be negative, violating norm nonnegativity and sign symmetry.

zh: 正式引入 exceptional functional，先定义 supported at x，再精简 1.1。
en: Introduce exceptional functional formally, define supported at x first, then shorten 1.1.

zh: 本笔记的 exceptional functional supported at x 是附带 presentation $(\pi:V\to X,H_1,H_2)$ 的线性泛函。模型光滑射影、双有理，扩张理想 $\mathcal I_x\mathcal O_V=\operatorname{Im}(\pi^*\mathcal I_x\to\mathcal O_V)$ 可逆且等于 $\mathcal O_V(-E_V)$。点与 presentation 都是数据；support 是本笔记约定，不是裸泛函天然唯一确定的标准支撑。
1.1 保留完整统一量词后，要求存在相应泛函；1.3 用 $\Phi(P+ND)<3/8$。主证明比较这两个界。特征约化前仍须固定 presentation；三个几何输入仍未在本框架独立核验。
en: In this note, an exceptional functional supported at x is a linear functional supplied with a presentation $(\pi:V\to X,H_1,H_2)$. The model is smooth, projective and birational, and $\mathcal I_x\mathcal O_V=\operatorname{Im}(\pi^*\mathcal I_x\to\mathcal O_V)$ is invertible and equals $\mathcal O_V(-E_V)$. Both point and presentation are data. “Support” is a convention of this note, not a standard intrinsic support of the bare functional.

After its full uniform quantifiers, 1.1 requires such a functional; 1.3 uses $\Phi(P+ND)<3/8$. The main assembly compares these bounds. The presentation must be fixed before reduction of characteristic; the three inputs remain independently unverified in the framework.

zh: n-jet 是茎商掉极大理想的 n 次方吗？
en: Is an n-jet the stalk modulo the nth power of the maximal ideal?

zh: 标准 n-jet 商掉 $\mathfrak m_x^{n+1}$，保留常数与所有总次数不超过 n 的项；商 $\mathfrak m_x^n$ 是 (n−1)-jet。线丛版本是 $L_x/\mathfrak m_x^{n+1}L_x$。这里只记问答，不加正文。
en: The standard n-jet is modulo $\mathfrak m_x^{n+1}$, including constants and all terms of total degree at most n. Modulo $\mathfrak m_x^n$ gives an (n−1)-jet. The line-bundle version is $L_x/\mathfrak m_x^{n+1}L_x$. This is recorded without adding it to the manuscript.

zh: Separates s-jets 能用除子或线性系的重数语言来写吗？
en: Can separating s-jets be expressed through divisor multiplicities or a linear system?

zh: 光滑 d 维 W 上，设 $\Lambda=|L|$ 非空，$\Lambda_{\ge s+1}(x)=\{E\in\Lambda:\operatorname{mult}_xE\ge s+1\}$，空系维数为 −1。分离 s-jets 等价于 $\dim\Lambda-\dim\Lambda_{\ge s+1}(x)=\binom{d+s}{d}$。
这表示高重数条件施加全部独立条件，仅存在高重数成员不足。源稿定义未改。
en: On a smooth d-dimensional W, let $\Lambda=|L|$ be nonempty and $\Lambda_{\ge s+1}(x)=\{E\in\Lambda:\operatorname{mult}_xE\ge s+1\}$, with dimension −1 for the empty system. Separating s-jets is equivalent to $\dim\Lambda-\dim\Lambda_{\ge s+1}(x)=\binom{d+s}{d}$.
The high-multiplicity condition must impose all independent conditions; existence of a high-multiplicity member is insufficient. The manuscript definition is unchanged.

zh: σ 和 u 的定义，是说 Taylor 展开的前 s 项相同吗？
en: Does the definition with σ and u mean that the first s Taylor terms agree?

zh: 对任意 $u\in\mathcal O_{W,z}(L)$，存在 $\sigma\in H^0(W,\mathcal O_W(L))$ 使 $\sigma_z-u\in\mathfrak m_z^{s+1}\mathcal O_{W,z}(L)$。包含常数和全部总次数不超过 s 的项，差消失阶至少 s+1。关键是对任意 u，不只是某一个 u。
en: For every $u\in\mathcal O_{W,z}(L)$, there is $\sigma\in H^0(W,\mathcal O_W(L))$ with $\sigma_z-u\in\mathfrak m_z^{s+1}\mathcal O_{W,z}(L)$. This includes constants and every term of total degree at most s; the difference vanishes to order at least s+1. The key is every u, not just one u.

zh: 后面的证明需要采用刚才的线性系余维公式吗？
en: Does the later proof need that linear-system codimension formula?

zh: 按现有 Threefold 稿无需采用该重述：直接使用任意 Taylor 数据可由全局截面实现，再用乘积提高 jets。后续还有矩阵秩与维数估计，但不是刚才的余维公式。这只核对稿中用法，不表示完整证明已验证。
en: The current Threefold draft does not need that reformulation: it realizes arbitrary Taylor data by global sections, then raises jets through products. Later steps include matrix-rank and dimension estimates, but not that codimension formula. This checks usage in the draft, not the full proof.

zh: $\mathcal O_{W,z}(L)$ 是什么？
en: What is $\mathcal O_{W,z}(L)$?

zh: 这是线丛的茎 $(\mathcal O_W(L))_z$，元素是局部截面芽。选局部标架 e 后 $u=fe$，$f\in\mathcal O_{W,z}$，是局部环上的自由秩一模。点的纤维需再商 $\mathfrak m_z\mathcal O_{W,z}(L)$；茎与纤维不同。
en: It is the line-bundle stalk $(\mathcal O_W(L))_z$, consisting of germs of local sections. A local frame e gives $u=fe$ with $f\in\mathcal O_{W,z}$, a free rank-one module over the local ring. The fibre is the further quotient by $\mathfrak m_z\mathcal O_{W,z}(L)$; stalk and fibre differ.

zh: 主定理的证明框架中，1.1、1.2、1.3 是怎么衔接的？
en: How do 1.1, 1.2 and 1.3 fit together in the theorem proof?

zh: 调用顺序是 1.2 → 1.1 → 1.3。先由 1.2 固定 N，并保证充分大 n 下存在允许的 k、z，使 $|kR_n|$ 分离 8k-jets。再对同一个 N 用 1.1 得到 $\Phi(P_n+ND)<40\epsilon<3/8$。
取同一个 n 大到 $343P_n^3<1/4$、$r_n>N$。因为 $P_n-r_nD$ nef，$(2P_n+ND)\cdot P_n^2\le(2+N/r_n)P_n^3<4P_n^3$。于是 1.3 取 $P=P_n$，禁止任何允许的 k、z 分离 8k-jets，与 1.2 选出的 k、z 矛盾。
这是假定三个输入成立后的逻辑衔接，不是对它们证明的验证；主证明正文段落结构未因这次问答改变。
en: The order is 1.2 → 1.1 → 1.3. First 1.2 fixes N and supplies admissible k, z for sufficiently large n such that $|kR_n|$ separates 8k-jets. Apply 1.1 for the same N to obtain $\Phi(P_n+ND)<40\epsilon<3/8$.

Choose the same n large enough that $343P_n^3<1/4$ and $r_n>N$. Since $P_n-r_nD$ is nef, $(2P_n+ND)\cdot P_n^2\le(2+N/r_n)P_n^3<4P_n^3$. With $P=P_n$, 1.3 rules out separation of 8k-jets for every admissible k, z, contradicting the choice supplied by 1.2.
This is the logical assembly assuming the three inputs, not verification of their proofs. This discussion does not change the paragraph structure of the theorem proof.

zh: Very ample 的判别是否等价于分离 one-jets？
en: Is very ampleness equivalent to separating one-jets?

zh: 在光滑点 x，分离 1-jets 等价于该点无基点并分离每个非零切向量 v：存在截面 $\sigma$ 满足 $\sigma(x)=0$ 且 $d\sigma_x(v)\ne0$（用局部标架表示导数）。
Very ample 还需要分离不同点；单点或逐点的 jet 分离不自动给出不同点分离。在 proper 情形，将分离不同点与切向量合起来才得到闭嵌入。参考 Stacks 0E8R：https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0E8R。
en: At a smooth point x, separation of 1-jets is equivalent to no base point at x together with separation of every nonzero tangent vector v: a section $\sigma$ vanishes at x with $d\sigma_x(v)\ne0$, computed in a local frame.

Very ampleness also requires separation of distinct points; pointwise jet separation does not automatically supply it. For a proper scheme, separation of points and tangent vectors together gives a closed immersion. See Stacks 0E8R: https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0E8R.

zh: 1.3 是否不用这么强，只针对 $P_n$ 做就好？
en: Can 1.3 be stated only for $P_n$ rather than arbitrary P?

zh: 可以，主证明只使用 $P=P_n$。任意 P 的版本可专门化为序列版本，Setup 只需 $R_n=P_{n,1}+P_{n,2}+N\xi$。
固定 N 后，由 $P_n^3\to\epsilon^3$、$343\epsilon^3<1/4$ 与 $r_n\to\infty$，可将两个数值条件吸收到 $n_1(\epsilon,N)$ 中。因为 $P_n-r_nD$ nef，$(2P_n+ND)\cdot P_n^2\le(2+N/r_n)P_n^3<4P_n^3$。这没有验证三个几何输入，只简化其在框架中的表述。
en: Yes: the main proof uses only $P=P_n$. The arbitrary-P input can be specialized to the sequence, and Setup needs only $R_n=P_{n,1}+P_{n,2}+N\xi$.

For fixed N, $P_n^3\to\epsilon^3$, $343\epsilon^3<1/4$ and $r_n\to\infty$ allow the two numerical conditions to be absorbed into $n_1(\epsilon,N)$. Since $P_n-r_nD$ is nef, $(2P_n+ND)\cdot P_n^2\le(2+N/r_n)P_n^3<4P_n^3$. This simplifies the framework statements; it does not verify the three geometric inputs.

zh: 将 1.3 专门写成 $P_n$ 版本，删除任意 P 和 $R(P,N)$ 缩写。
en: Specialize 1.3 to $P_n$ and remove arbitrary P and the abbreviation $R(P,N)$.

zh: 1.3 现在对每个 N 给出 $n_1(\epsilon,N)$；对所有 $n\ge n_1$，若存在 supported-at-x 的 $\Phi$ 满足 $\Phi(P_n+ND)<3/8$，则所有允许的 k、z 都不能使 $|kR_n|$ 分离 8k-jets。数值条件在其后检查一次；主证明直接调用。1.1、1.2 与 $40\epsilon$ 保持。
en: For each N, 1.3 now gives $n_1(\epsilon,N)$: for every $n\ge n_1$, existence of a functional supported at x with $\Phi(P_n+ND)<3/8$ prevents $|kR_n|$ from separating 8k-jets for every admissible k, z. The numerical conditions are checked once afterward, and the main proof invokes the input directly. Lemmas 1.1, 1.2 and $40\epsilon$ are retained.

zh: $P_n$ 与 $R_n$ 不在同一个 variety 上，为什么 1.3 与 1.2 矛盾？
en: $P_n$ and $R_n$ are on different varieties, so why do 1.3 and 1.2 contradict each other?

zh: $P_n$ 在 X 上，而 Z 上的 $R_n=q^*p_1^*P_n+q^*p_2^*P_n+N\xi$，其中 $q:Z\to X\times X$。1.3 的条件使用 X 上的 $P_n$，但结论仍是关于 Z 上的 $|kR_n|$，不是关于 $|kP_n|$。
对同一个 N、n，1.2 给出存在允许的 k、$z\in\mathbb T$ 能分离 8k-jets，1.3 却禁止任何允许的 k、z 分离。因此它们讨论的是同一空间上同一个线性系，构成矛盾。
en: $P_n$ is on X, while $R_n=q^*p_1^*P_n+q^*p_2^*P_n+N\xi$ is on Z, with $q:Z\to X\times X$. The hypothesis of 1.3 uses $P_n$ on X, but its conclusion is about $|kR_n|$ on Z, not $|kP_n|$.

For the same N, n, 1.2 supplies an admissible k and $z\in\mathbb T$ separating 8k-jets; 1.3 forbids separation for every admissible k, z. Both conclusions concern the same linear system on the same space.

zh: 1.3 需要 1.1 是不是？
en: Does 1.3 require 1.1?

zh: 1.3 是条件式引理，陈述本身不引用 1.1。主证明应用它时，用 1.1 提供满足 $\Phi(P_n+ND)<40\epsilon<3/8$ 的泛函；然后 1.3 的禁止分离结论与 1.2 的存在性矛盾。这只是三个输入之间的逻辑关系，不是它们证明已被独立核验。
en: Lemma 1.3 is conditional and does not cite 1.1 in its statement. The main proof uses 1.1 to provide a functional with $\Phi(P_n+ND)<40\epsilon<3/8$, then contradicts the existence in 1.2 by the prohibition in 1.3. This explains the logical relation among the inputs, not independent verification of their proofs.

zh: 生成 jets 的结论由哪条得到？这样的矛盾是不是文字游戏？
en: Where does jet generation come from? Is the contradiction just a word game?

zh: 生成 jets 是第三个独立几何输入，不由小泛函条件推出，现编号 1.3。禁止 jets 是满足泛函条件后的新 1.2。在共同反证假设下，三个输入若都成立则产生矛盾；这不能替代其几何证明，本 Framework 尚未独立验证三个输入。
en: Jet generation is the third independent geometric input, not a consequence of the small-functional condition, and is now 1.3. Prohibition is the conditional input, now 1.2. Under the common contradiction hypothesis, the three inputs would yield a contradiction if all hold; this cannot replace their geometric proofs, which the Framework has not independently verified.

zh: 让 1.1 和禁止 jets 的引理配对，生成 jets 放最后；1.1 只需存在一点，并删去 support 术语。
en: Pair 1.1 with the obstruction, put generation last, weaken 1.1 to one-point existence and remove support terminology.

zh: 最终顺序为 1.1 存在 exceptional functional；1.2 在相应条件下禁止所有允许的 k、z 分离 jets；1.3 提供某组 k、z 分离 jets。点不再另写在两条陈述中，而是包含在泛函的构造数据 $(x,\pi:V\to X,H_1,H_2)$。定义不再使用 support/supported-at-x。1.1 删除 very general 与 $Z_j$ 要求，保留原参数及未独立核验状态。
en: The final order is: 1.1 supplies an exceptional functional; 1.2 conditionally forbids jet separation for all admissible k, z; 1.3 supplies a pair with separation. The point is implicit in the construction data $(x,\pi:V\to X,H_1,H_2)$, rather than separately stated in the first two inputs. The definition no longer uses support/supported-at-x. The very-general and $Z_j$ requirements are removed from 1.1; original parameters and unverified status remain.

zh: 只用一个点，1.1 可以弱化为存在一点吧？
en: Since only one point is used, can 1.1 be weakened to one-point existence?

zh: 可以。禁止 jets 的输入只要求存在一个构造所得的 $\Phi$ 使 $\Phi(P_n+ND)<3/8$，点隐含在其数据中。因此每个相关 n 只需找到一个点及泛函使取值小于 $40\epsilon$；无需在这里要求很一般点或统一可数例外集。
en: Yes. The obstruction requires one constructed functional with $\Phi(P_n+ND)<3/8$, with its point implicit in the data. For each relevant n, one point and functional with value below $40\epsilon$ suffice; a very-general assertion or uniform countable exceptional set is unnecessary here.

zh: 把 1.1 所需的全部初始假设补齐。
en: Include all initial hypotheses used by 1.1.

zh: 1.1 现列明 X 是复数域上的光滑射影三维，$K_X\sim0$、$q(X)=0$；D nef Cartier，$\operatorname{n}(X,D)=3$、$D^3=0$、$\kappa(D)=-\infty$；A ample Cartier；$\epsilon\in\mathbb Q_{>0}$ 满足 $343\epsilon^3<1/4$ 与 $40\epsilon<3/8$，并使用 Setup 的归一化 $P_n$ 序列。主证明在共同反证假设下先由 1.3 选 N，再取同一个充分大 n，由 1.1 和 1.2 与 1.3 矛盾。这没有验证三个输入或声称这些是假设的最弱形式。
en: Lemma 1.1 now lists a smooth projective threefold X over the complex numbers, $K_X\sim0$, $q(X)=0$; nef Cartier D with $\operatorname{n}(X,D)=3$, $D^3=0$, $\kappa(D)=-\infty$; ample Cartier A; and $\epsilon\in\mathbb Q_{>0}$ with $343\epsilon^3<1/4$, $40\epsilon<3/8$, using the normalized $P_n$ sequence from Setup. Under the common contradiction hypothesis, the main proof chooses N by 1.3 and one sufficiently large n, then contradicts 1.3 using 1.1 and 1.2. This neither verifies the three inputs nor asserts minimal hypotheses.

zh: 把产生 jets 与禁止 jets 的引理所用假设分别写清楚。
en: State explicitly the hypotheses used for jet generation and jet obstruction.

zh: 现将 1.2、1.3 的初始假设明示。1.2 不要求反证假设或第二个 epsilon 界，但需要额外的小泛函条件以及充分大 n 对应的体积条件；1.3 则与 1.1 采用相同的全套初始假设。编号不变，几何输入的证明仍未独立核验。
en: The initial hypotheses of 1.2 and 1.3 are now explicit. Lemma 1.2 does not require the contradiction hypothesis or the second epsilon bound, but requires the additional small-functional condition and the volume conditions for sufficiently large n. Lemma 1.3 uses the same full initial hypotheses as 1.1. Numbering is unchanged, and the geometric inputs remain independently unverified.

zh: 我比较的是 1.1 和 1.3：它们的初始条件有什么不同？
en: I am comparing 1.1 with 1.3: how do their initial hypotheses differ?

zh: 在当前稿中，它们的初始假设相同，包括 $\kappa(D)=-\infty$。此前将这一假设说成两者的区别不适用于这个比较。区别在结论及量词：1.1 是对每个 $N>0$、每个充分大 n，存在 $\Phi$ 使 $\Phi(P_n+ND)<40\epsilon$；1.3 是存在某个 $N>0$，使每个充分大 n 都存在允许的 k、z，令 $|kR_n|$ 分离 $8k$-jets。1.3 无需预先给定小泛函。
en: In the current draft their initial hypotheses coincide, including $\kappa(D)=-\infty$. Treating that assumption as a difference between them did not answer this comparison. Their conclusions and quantifiers differ: 1.1 gives, for every $N>0$ and every sufficiently large n, a functional $\Phi$ with $\Phi(P_n+ND)<40\epsilon$; 1.3 provides some $N>0$ for which every sufficiently large n admits admissible k, z with $|kR_n|$ separating $8k$-jets. Lemma 1.3 does not require a small functional as an input.

zh: 把 1.1 和 1.2 合起来与 1.3 比较，矛盾究竟来自哪里？这是不是因为先作了反证假设？
en: Comparing 1.1 together with 1.2 against 1.3, where does the contradiction arise? Is it because we first make a contradiction assumption?

zh: 在共同几何假设下暂设 $\kappa(D)=-\infty$。一条路线由 1.1 得到小 $\Phi$，再满足 1.2 的额外条件，禁止 jets；另一条路线由 1.3 产生 jets。取 1.3 给出的 N，随后取满足三个输入的同一个充分大 n，两条路线作用于 Z 上同一个 $|kR_n|$。若三个几何输入均成立，则可排除 $\kappa(D)=-\infty$；这不是声称两个无条件的相反结论同时成立，也不能凭该逻辑结构确认三个输入的证明。
en: Under the common geometric hypotheses, assume temporarily that $\kappa(D)=-\infty$. One route uses 1.1 to obtain a small $\Phi$, satisfying the extra condition of 1.2 and prohibiting jets. The other uses 1.3 to generate jets. Choose N from 1.3 and then the same sufficiently large n for all three inputs; both routes concern the same $|kR_n|$ on Z. If all three geometric inputs hold, they exclude $\kappa(D)=-\infty$. This does not assert two opposite unconditional conclusions simultaneously, and the logical structure does not verify the proofs of those inputs.

zh: Very ample 能推出每点分离 one jet 吗？我现在只想理解 jets 的基本含义。
en: Does very ampleness imply separation of one jet at every point? I only want to understand the basic meaning of jets.

zh: 能。无基点保证取值，一阶切向量分离保证一次项，两者合起来就是每点分离 1-jets：在局部平凡化下，截面的常数项和全部一次项可以独立指定。Very ample 还要求分离不同点；只谈切向量而省略取值或点分离，不是完整的判据。Hartshorne II, Proposition 7.3(2) 用在该点消失的截面生成 $\mathfrak m_pL_p/\mathfrak m_p^2L_p$ 来表述切向量分离。原文参考：https://djvu.online/file/nBitrL383m1P0 。
en: Yes. Base-point freedom controls the value, while tangent-vector separation controls the linear terms; together they give 1-jet separation at every point. After local trivialization, the constant and all linear terms can be prescribed independently. Very ampleness also requires separation of distinct points. Hartshorne II, Proposition 7.3(2) expresses tangent-vector separation by generation of $\mathfrak m_pL_p/\mathfrak m_p^2L_p$ by sections vanishing at p. Source: https://djvu.online/file/nBitrL383m1P0 .

zh: Setup 中 $\xi$ 是 nef class 吗？那么 $R_n$ 是 ample 吗？
en: Is $\xi$ in Setup nef? Is $R_n$ then ample?

zh: 这里 $\xi=c_1(\mathcal O_Z(1))$。按当前射影丛约定，$\xi$ 是 nef，且在射影丛纤维上为正；加上来自底空间的 ample 类 $P_{n,1}+P_{n,2}$，$R_n$ 确为 ample。适当的充分大整数倍可以 very ample，但这本身不保证随 k 增长的 $8k$-jets 分离。
en: Here $\xi=c_1(\mathcal O_Z(1))$. With the present projective-bundle convention, it is nef and positive on the fibers. Adding the ample class $P_{n,1}+P_{n,2}$ pulled back from the base makes $R_n$ ample. Suitable sufficiently large integral multiples can be very ample, but this alone does not guarantee separation of $8k$-jets growing with k.

zh: 分离点可以找除子经过 P 而不经过 Q。曲面上分离两个切方向怎么类比？
en: To separate points, a divisor can pass through P but not Q. What is the analogous statement for two tangent directions on a surface?

zh: 在光滑曲面上，设线性系 $\Lambda$ 无基点并在 p 分离切向量。给定不同切方向 $\ell_1\ne\ell_2\subset T_pX$，可取 $E\in\Lambda$，使 E 在 p 光滑且 $T_pE=\ell_1$，因此其切线不包含 $\ell_2$。对给定方向也可取横着经过 p 的 E。例子是 $\mathbb P^2$ 上的直线系：经过 p 的直线可以有任意指定斜率。这是曲面上的切线表述；高维除子的切空间是超平面，不能说它只有一个切方向。
en: On a smooth surface, suppose a base-point-free system $\Lambda$ separates tangent vectors at p. For distinct tangent lines $\ell_1\ne\ell_2\subset T_pX$, one can choose $E\in\Lambda$ smooth at p with $T_pE=\ell_1$, so its tangent line does not contain $\ell_2$. One can also choose E transverse to a specified direction. For example, lines through p in $\mathbb P^2$ can have any prescribed slope. This is a surface statement: the tangent space of a smooth divisor in higher dimension is a hyperplane, not a single direction.

zh: 用 Hartshorne 的生成、满射方式写 jets 定义，原稿仍保留一般 s。
en: Write the jet definition using generation or surjectivity in the style of Hartshorne, retaining general s.

zh: 已将定义写为：对所有 $j=0,\ldots,s$，在 z 消失至少 j 阶的全局截面之 germ 类满射到 $\mathfrak m_z^jL_z/\mathfrak m_z^{j+1}L_z$。必须包括全部 j：j=0 控制取值，j=1 控制一次项，更高 j 控制对应阶次。各层依次提升，与原先模 $\mathfrak m_z^{s+1}L_z$ 任意指定 germ 的定义等价。原书 II, Proposition 7.3(2) 只给出一阶切向量判据，不把一般 s 的写法归为原书原定义。其余引理、条件与常数未变。
en: The definition now requires, for every $j=0,\ldots,s$, that germ classes of global sections vanishing to order at least j at z surject onto $\mathfrak m_z^jL_z/\mathfrak m_z^{j+1}L_z$. All layers are required: j=0 controls values, j=1 linear terms, and higher j the corresponding degrees. Successive lifting through these layers is equivalent to prescribing any germ modulo $\mathfrak m_z^{s+1}L_z$. Hartshorne II, Proposition 7.3(2) concerns only first-order tangent-vector separation; the general-s formulation is not attributed to that proposition as its original definition. The other lemmas, hypotheses and constants are unchanged.

zh: 即使 very ample，一般也无法分离 s-jets 吗？它可以理解成分离点并分离每点的 one jet 吗？
en: Even if a divisor is very ample, can it generally not separate s-jets? Does very ampleness mean separating points and one jet at each point?

zh: 最后这个理解正确。对 $s\ge2$，准确说法是 very ample 不保证分离 s-jets，而非必定不能。例如在 $\mathbb P^2$ 上，$\mathcal O(1)$ 很充足，但在仿射坐标 u,v 下截面只有 $a+bu+cv$，不能模 $(u,v)^3$ 实现 $u^2$，所以不分离 2-jets。更强的线丛可以分离高阶 jets；例如 $\mathcal O_{\mathbb P^2}(d)$ 在每点可实现次数不超过 d 的全部局部多项式。
en: The latter understanding is correct. For $s\ge2$, very ampleness does not guarantee s-jet separation, rather than making it impossible. For example, $\mathcal O(1)$ on $\mathbb P^2$ is very ample, but in affine coordinates u, v its sections have the form $a+bu+cv$, so they cannot realize $u^2$ modulo $(u,v)^3$; it does not separate 2-jets. Stronger line bundles can separate higher jets: $\mathcal O_{\mathbb P^2}(d)$ realizes every local polynomial of degree at most d at each point.

zh: 单独整理名为 Jets 的笔记：写清 jets 和分离 jets 的定义、几种等价理解、分离性的几何表现，以及 very ample 的判据、反例和充分大倍数的情形。
en: Prepare a separate note titled Jets, with definitions and equivalent interpretations, geometric separation, the very-ampleness criterion, counterexamples, and sufficiently large powers.

zh: 笔记从 stalk 与 fibre 的区别、局部 Taylor 多项式及逐阶生成开始，证明全 jets 与全部分次层满射的等价性，以及高重数截面子空间的余维判据。随后说明一阶 jets、切向量和不同点的分离，给出完整线性系的曲线及曲面反例，最后证明 very ample 除子的倍数生成固定阶 jets。
en: The note begins with stalks versus fibres, local Taylor polynomials and graded generation, proving the equivalence with full jet generation and the codimension criterion for high-order vanishing sections. It then treats first jets, tangent vectors and distinct points, gives curve and surface counterexamples using complete linear systems, and proves fixed-order jet generation for powers of a very ample divisor.

zh: 能给出完整线性系在每点分离 one jet，却不是 very ample 的例子吗？
en: Can a complete linear system separate one jet at every point without being very ample?

zh: 可以。取平面四次曲线 $X_0^4+X_1^4+(X_1^2-X_0^2)X_2^2=0$ 的正规化 C。该曲线只有一个普通节点；故 $g(C)=2$，拉回直线丛 L 的次数为 4，Riemann–Roch 给出 $h^0(C,L)=3$。三个坐标截面就是完整线性系，所得映射处处 immersive，却将节点的两个原像识别，因此在每点生成 1-jets 但不 very ample。取 $C\times\mathbb P^1$ 上的外积 $L\boxtimes\mathcal O(1)$，得到同样性质的 ample 曲面线丛。这里没有用投影子线性系代替完整线性系。
en: Yes. Normalize the plane quartic $X_0^4+X_1^4+(X_1^2-X_0^2)X_2^2=0$. Its only singularity is an ordinary node, so the normalization C has genus 2. The pulled-back line bundle L has degree 4 and $h^0(C,L)=3$ by Riemann–Roch. Its three coordinate sections give the complete linear system. The morphism is immersive everywhere but identifies the two preimages of the node; thus it generates 1-jets at every point without being very ample. The external product $L\boxtimes\mathcal O(1)$ on $C\times\mathbb P^1$ gives an ample surface example. These are complete systems, not projected subsystems.

zh: 任何 very ample 除子的充分大倍数都能分离固定的 s-jets 吗？
en: Do sufficiently large multiples of any very ample divisor separate fixed s-jets?

zh: 是。若 A very ample，则 $mA$ 在每点生成 s-jets，只需 $m\ge s\ge1$。用 A 嵌入射影空间，取不在该点消失的 $X_0$，并使其余坐标在该点为零。对 $|\alpha|\le s$，齐次多项式 $X_0^{m-|\alpha|}\prod X_i^{\alpha_i}$ 给出局部单项式 $u^\alpha$，这些单项式生成模 $\mathfrak m_x^{s+1}$ 的全部类。不需要假定 projective normality。这里 s 固定；没有说固定倍数能生成任意高阶 jets。
en: Yes. If A is very ample, $mA$ generates s-jets at every point for $m\ge s\ge1$. Embed by A, choose a coordinate $X_0$ nonvanishing at the point and the remaining coordinates vanishing there. For $|\alpha|\le s$, the homogeneous polynomial $X_0^{m-|\alpha|}\prod X_i^{\alpha_i}$ gives the local monomial $u^\alpha$. These monomials span all classes modulo $\mathfrak m_x^{s+1}$. Projective normality is not required. The order s is fixed; a fixed multiple is not asserted to generate arbitrarily high jets.

zh: 维数用 n，初始 Cartier 除子用 D，不需要花体 L，直接写 O_X(D)。
en: Use n for the dimension and D for the initial Cartier divisor; remove the calligraphic L alias and write O_X(D) explicitly.

zh: 已统一为 $\dim X=n$、Cartier 除子 D，并在定义、满射条件、stalk、余维命题及例子中显式使用 $\mathcal O_X(D)$。原有数学内容保留。
en: The note now uses $\dim X=n$, the Cartier divisor D, and explicit $\mathcal O_X(D)$ in the definitions, surjectivity conditions, stalks, codimension criterion and examples. The mathematical content is retained.

zh: 对线性系来定义更好：$\Lambda\subseteq|D|$。
en: It is better to formulate the definition for a linear system $\Lambda\subseteq|D|$.

zh: 现固定非空子系 $\Lambda=\mathbb P(V)\subseteq|D|$，其中 $V\subseteq H^0(X,\mathcal O_X(D))$ 是非零线性子空间。jets 生成、全部分次层满射、余维等价条件及 one-jets 判据均对这个 V 和子系陈述。两种反例仍明确采用完整线性系，倍数定理仍针对 $|mA|$。
en: We now fix a nonempty subsystem $\Lambda=\mathbb P(V)\subseteq|D|$, where $V\subseteq H^0(X,\mathcal O_X(D))$ is a nonzero linear subspace. Jet generation, surjectivity on all graded layers, the codimension equivalence and the one-jet criterion are stated for this V and subsystem. Both counterexamples still explicitly use complete linear systems, and the power theorem concerns $|mA|$.

sourceTheorem.title: Numerical Semiampleness of Nef Adjoint Divisors
sourceTheorem.label: Theorem · thm:main
sourceTheorem.text:
Let $(X,B)$ be a projective klt $\Q$-pair over an algebraically closed
field of characteristic zero. Suppose that $K_X+B$ is pseudo-effective,
and let $M$ be a nef $\Q$-Cartier divisor on $X$. If
\[
                         D=K_X+B+M
\]
is nef, then there is a semiample $\Q$-Cartier divisor $L$ on $X$ such
that $D\equiv L$.
